jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Engineer - Robotic Systems
jobs.description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.



Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission. Every one of these solutions starts as physical hardware — robotic workcells that we design, build, and commission in our own labs before they go into production.



We are looking for a passionate Senior Mechanical Engineer for Robotic Systems to turn robotics concepts into reliable physical systems. In this role, you will design the mechanical parts of our workcells, build and assemble them in our labs, and make sure they meet the relevant safety standards. You will own our lab infrastructure, tooling, and material, and be the hands\-on partner for our robotics, software, and application engineers. The role is based in Munich, Germany.


#### **Responsibilities**


* Design mechanical parts, fixtures, grippers, mounts, and enclosures for the robotic workcells in our labs and in customer projects
* Validate workcell and production line concepts in simulation — reachability, collisions, and cycle times — before any hardware is built
* Construct, assemble, and commission complete robotic workcells — from the frame and mounting concept to cabling and final integration
* Create and maintain CAD models, technical drawings, and bills of materials, and prepare parts for manufacturing via CAM and 3D printing
* Build up a library of reusable mechanical modules, standard components, and design templates, and feed lessons learned from existing workcells back into it, so that each new cell is faster to design than the last
* Own the organization of our labs, including tools, equipment, material stock, and the procurement of mechanical components
* Ensure that our workcells adhere to the relevant machine safety norms and support risk assessments, safeguarding concepts, and technical documentation
* Work closely with robotics, software, and application engineers to translate application requirements into robust mechanical solutions
* Travel to customer and deployment sites to support the installation, commissioning, and on\-site adaptation of workcells (up to 20% of working time)

#### **Essential Skills**


* Degree in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience, e.g. a technical apprenticeship with several years of relevant work
* Minimum of four years of professional experience in mechanical design, machine building, or industrial automation

jobs.title: Senior Electrical Engineer (Integrations)
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!


Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.


We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.


It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

**Kraken Generation Flex**
--------------------------


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In Germany, home to the largest electricity market in Europe and a roadmap toward Net Zero by 2045, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.


Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. We are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As we expand our footprint in Germany and the wider European market, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to lead our regional technical market\-access and integration efforts.

**Where you’ll fit in and role summary**
----------------------------------------


As we enter a stage of rapid commercialisation and customer growth in Germany, we are looking for a Senior Electrical Engineer to work with stakeholders to develop our DSR (Demand Side Response) and flexibility pipeline.


You will be bringing your **regional technical expertise** to aid the development of our asset integration technologies. The role is highly cross\-functional: you'll bridge our software and hardware capabilities with the rigorous requirements of the four German Transmission System Operators (TSOs) and 900\+ Distribution System Operators (DSOs).


The detailed Gateway (Kraken’s IoT Edge Hardware\&Software) configuration and protocol engineering is owned by our UK\-based team, whom you will feed with regional knowledge and design input, and who will support you on the technical aspects of how Kraken integrations work. You will own the regional relationship, the integration approach, and the design that the UK team then implements. The role may require you to attend customer calls, as well as calls with the TSO and DSOs to technically explain/defend our strategy.


You will join a team, based in Manchester, that is innovative and engineering\-focused, with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Market Access \& Prequalification:** Drive the technical approach for connecting assets — mainly BESS (grid\-scale and C\&I) and RES (Wind and Solar) into German ancillary\-service markets (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) and Redispatch 3\.0\. Support **prequalification (Präqualifikation)** with the relevant TSO and ensure our telemetry and control approach satisfies TSO\-specific and BNetzA requirements for market participation. *(Grid\-code and plant\-compliance obligations such as VDE\-AR\-N 4110/4120 remain with the plant/PPC; your focus is enabling market access, telemetry, and dispatch.)*
* **Integration Technology (your core deliverable):** Carry out research, engage technical stakeholders and engineers to design our established integration approaches for various asset types such as BESS, Wind, Solar, CHP and more. This can cover both new projects and retrofits.
* **Regional Technical Expertise:** Be the regional authority who feeds and supports the UK team with knowledge of German hardware requirements, industrial protocols, connectivity, cyber\-security expectations, and TSO/DSO and ancillary\-service requirements. Help evaluate hardware and connectivity solutions for regional fit.
* **Stakeholder Liaison:** Act as the technical point of contact for TSOs, DSOs, customers, and internal commercial teams to resolve connection, onboarding, or operational issues.
* **Hardware \& On\-site Support (occasional):** Hardware is deployed remotely in most cases via O\&Ms and third parties. However, occasional regional support and hands\-on intervention may be required before or after a deployment, including some hardware handling and on\-site engineering. You’ll ideally be based close to **Kraken’s Berlin office** and the role requires the ability to travel when needed, though this is kept to a minimum.

**What you'll bring to the party**
----------------------------------

* **Language:** Native or professional fluency in **German and English**, essential for technical documentation and TSO/regulator communication.
* **Engineering background:** Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, or a related field (**or equivalent practical experience** in industrial/energy integration).
* **Integration \& connectivity:** Proven experience establishing industrial communication and connectivity between field equipment and external systems (telemetry and/or control).
* **Power\-plant systems:** Working understanding of power\-plant control systems and instrumentation, including metering.
* **German market knowledge:**


	+ TSO/DSO hierarchy and the connection/integration process.
	+ Ancillary services (FCR, aFRR, mFRR) prequalification and technical requirements.
	+ Redispatch 3\.0 regulatory framework.
* **Customer\-facing delivery:** Ability to produce technical integration approaches and communicate them to customers, regulators, and internal teams.
* **Travel:** Occasional travel may be required.
* **A drive to get things done in a collaborative, agile environment**, comfortable navigating the complexity of a multi\-TSO, decentralised grid, and comfortable being the regional face of a technical function whose deep build sits with a partner team in the UK.

**️ Bonus points**
------------------

* Knowledge of industrial communication protocols: **IEC 60870\-5\-104, IEC 61400\-25 (wind), OPC\-UA, Modbus**, or similar IEC protocols.
* Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (**NIS2, EnWG/KRITIS awareness**; IEC 62443 a plus).
* Familiarity with **CLI tools** for configuring, diagnosing, and maintaining hardware or network connections in remote, Linux\-based environments.
* Familiarity with software languages, version\-controlled configuration, and general tooling.
* Exposure to the wider European balancing markets / ENTSO\-E frameworks beyond Germany.

If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. jobs.title: Forward Deployed AI Engineer
jobs.description:
Agile Robots SE is an innovative company with a clear mission: bringing intelligent robotic solutions to our customers. We combine the latest technology in the field of AI with powerful robotic systems — from industrial robot arms and mobile manipulators to humanoids — to solve tasks that classical automation cannot address.



At the heart of our offering is a versatile software platform for orchestrating complex robotic systems. It allows efficient customization for specific customer requirements: configuring systems, developing reusable skills, parameterizing processes, and executing tasks reliably in production. Learned models — from perception to end\-to\-end policies — are a core part of this platform.



Our solutions are deployed with international customers across a wide range of industries. Seamless integration and scalable deployment are at the core of our mission.



We are looking for a passionate Forward Deployed AI Engineer to bring state\-of\-the\-art robot learning and computer vision models into real production environments. In this role, you will train, fine\-tune, and deploy AI models directly on customer robots — from Vision\-Language\-Action models and diffusion policies to perception and grasp generation networks. You will become a trusted technical partner, turning customer challenges into robust, data\-driven robotics applications. The role is based in Munich, Germany.

* Deploy, fine\-tune, and evaluate AI models on real robotic systems at customer sites — including Vision\-Language\-Action (VLA) models, diffusion policies, and other end\-to\-end learned policies

* Build data pipelines for customer deployments: demonstration and teleoperation recording, dataset curation, annotation, training runs, and systematic evaluation of model performance
* Bring models into production: optimize inference, deploy on edge and embedded hardware, and integrate models into our robotic software platform
* Work closely with customers to understand technical requirements and translate them into robust, AI\-driven robotics applications

* Master's degree in Robotics, Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, or a related field — or equivalent practical experience

* Experience with learned grasp generation for manipulation (e.g., GraspNet, Dex\-Net, or comparable approaches)
* Good understanding of robot (inverse) kinematics, coordinate transformations, and hand\-eye calibration
* Experience working in Linux environments
* Willingness to learn new technologies and adapt quickly in customer environments
* Fluency in English

#### **Beneficial Skills**


* Experience with large\-scale demonstration data collection, teleoperation setups, and sim\-to\-real transfer
* Experience with robot learning simulation frameworks (e.g., NVIDIA Isaac Sim/Lab, MuJoCo, Gazebo)
* Good understanding of classical computer vision (e.g., OpenCV, PCL, camera calibration, point cloud processing)
* Experience optimizing inference (e.g., TensorRT, ONNX, quantization) and deploying on NVIDIA embedded platforms (e.g., Jetson Orin, AGX, Xavier)
* Experience with MLOps tooling: experiment tracking, dataset versioning, and continuous training or evaluation pipelines

* Familiarity with industrial automation environments (e.g., PLCs, EtherCAT, OPC UA)

* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills — able to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues
* Solid understanding of CI/CD pipelines, software quality practices (performance, scalability, security, testability)

jobs.title: CO-ABTEILUNGSLEITER*IN - DIGITAL HEALTH ENGINEERING
jobs.description:
Die Fraunhofer\-Gesellschaft ist eine der weltweit führenden Organisationen für anwendungsorientierte Forschung. 74 Institute entwickeln wegweisende Technologien für unsere Wirtschaft und Gesellschaft – genauer: 30 000 Menschen aus Technik, Wissenschaft, Verwaltung und IT. Sie wissen: Wer zu Fraunhofer kommt, will und kann etwas verändern. Für sich, für uns und die Märkte von heute und morgen.


Du arbeitest als Co\-Abteilungsleiter\*in in der Abteilung Digital Health Engineering am Standort Kaiserslautern. Die Abteilung Digital Health Engineering (DHE) wurde 2022 gegründet und wird weiter aufgebaut. Du bist also ganz vorne mit dabei, kannst deine Ideen mit einbringen und zur Entwicklung der Abteilung beitragen! Wir beschäftigen uns mit Forschungsfragen rund um das Design und Engineering von verlässlichen Gesundheitslösungen der Zukunft und transferieren diese in die Industrie. Dies reicht von der Identifikation innovativer Anwendungsfälle bis hin zur Umsetzung konkreter Lösungen. Die Abteilung beschäftigt sich schwerpunktmäßig mit Dependable Artificial Intelligence und Dateninteroperabilität (FHIR) für den Gesundheitsbereich und weiteren spannenden Themen, wie beispielsweise auch militär\-medizinischen Themen.

  


**Hier sorgst Du für Veränderung**


* Du übernimmst im Rahmen einer Doppelspitze den weiteren Aufbau und die Führung einer Gruppe von wissenschaftlichen Mitarbeitenden.
* Du bist mitverantwortlich für die Strategieentwicklung und die Forschungsroadmap der Abteilung
* Du trägst zum Business Development der Abteilung bei und entwickelst Wertversprechen und Services für den Industrietransfer
* Du arbeitest in spannenden und abwechslungsreichen Forschungs\- und Kundenprojekten mit namenhaften Partnern aus Forschung und Industrie zusammen
* Du beschäftigst dich mit Themen und Herausforderungen rund um Daten und Software im Gesundheitsbereich, z. B. KI\-Anwendungen rundum LLMs, Simulationen, Softwarelösungen usw.
* Du trägst mit deinem Knowhow zu Anträgen für Förderprojekte und Angeboten an industrielle Kunden bei und übernimmst die Leitung von Projekten
* Du präsentierst Ergebnisse bei Auftraggebern sowie auf Konferenzen und Fachtagungen
* Du arbeitest dich in vielseitige Themen ein und entwickelst deine Kompetenzen kontinuierlich weiter
* Du bringst dein Knowhow in verschiedenen Teams ein, diskutierst und forschst mit unterschiedlichen Talenten und disziplinübergreifend

  


**Hiermit bringst Du Dich ein**


* Abgeschlossenes wissenschaftliches Hochschulstudium (Diplom oder Master, ggfs. Promotion). Das Studienfach sollte einen klaren Bezug zur Informatik, Data Science und/oder Medizininformatik haben
* Mindestens 5 Jahre Berufserfahrung in der angewandten Forschung und Erfahrung im Business Development wären wünschenswert
* Du bringst Programmierkenntnisse in z.B. Python, JAVA, ggfs. C\#/C\+\+ mit
* Du besitzt Kenntnisse im Bereich Data Science, Künstlicher Intelligenz, Digital Health und/oder Software Engineering
* Du hast sehr gute Deutsch\- und Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift (mindestens Level C1\)
* Du willst gemeinsam im Team etwas bewegen
* Du bringst eine proaktive und eigenständige Arbeitsweise, Eigeninitiative und Kommunikationsstärke mit
* Du bist kreativ, neugierig und interessierst dich für Neues und Innovationen
* Du kannst dich leicht motivieren und bringst innovative Ideen ein

  


**Was wir für Dich bereithalten**



Als wissenschaftliche\*r Mitarbeiter\*in und Führungskraft bist du bei uns Teil eines engagierten und kollegialen Teams, das dich bereits während der Einarbeitung umfassend unterstützt. Am Fraunhofer IESE leben wir eine familienfreundliche und internationale Kultur. Wir bieten die Möglichkeit flexibler Arbeitszeiten und mobiles Arbeitens, um individuelle Anliegen zu berücksichtigen. Wir bieten dir persönliche Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten durch Weiterbildungsmaßnahmen, eine betriebliche Altersvorsorge (VBL) sowie Zugang zu einem vergünstigten Deutschland\-Jobticket.

  



Wir wertschätzen und fördern die Vielfalt der Kompetenzen unserer Mitarbeitenden und begrüßen daher alle Bewerbungen – unabhängig von Alter, Geschlecht, Nationalität, ethnischer und sozialer Herkunft, Religion, Weltanschauung, Behinderung sowie sexueller Orientierung und Identität. Schwerbehinderte Menschen werden bei gleicher Eignung bevorzugt eingestellt. Unsere Aufgaben sind vielfältig und anpassbar – für Bewerber\*innen mit Behinderung finden wir gemeinsam Lösungen, die ihre Fähigkeiten optimal fördern.

  



Die wöchentliche Arbeitszeit beträgt 39 Stunden. Die Stelle kann auch in Teilzeit besetzt werden. Anstellung, Vergütung und Sozialleistungen richten sich nach dem Tarifvertrag für den öffentlichen Dienst (TVöD).

  



Mit ihrer Fokussierung auf zukunftsrelevante Schlüsseltechnologien sowie auf die Verwertung der Ergebnisse in Wirtschaft und Industrie spielt die Fraunhofer\-Gesellschaft eine zentrale Rolle im Innovationsprozess. Als Wegweiser und Impulsgeber für innovative Entwicklungen und wissenschaftliche Exzellenz wirkt sie mit an der Gestaltung unserer Gesellschaft und unserer Zukunft.


**Bereit für Veränderung? Dann bewirb Dich jetzt, und mach einen Unterschied! Nach Eingang Deiner Online\-Bewerbung erhältst Du eine automatische Empfangsbestätigung. Dann melden wir uns schnellstmöglich und sagen Dir, wie es weitergeht.**

  

Bei Rückfragen zur Stellenausschreibung wende dich bitte per E\-Mail an:



Florian Gogolin



florian.gogolin@iese.fraunhofer.de



Fraunhofer\-Institut für Experimentelles Software Engineering IESE

jobs.title: Software Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
**About The Company**



GROPYUS is a technology\-based construction company focused on building multi\-story residential buildings. Thanks to its prefabricated building system with various design options, industrial offsite construction, and fully digitalized processes, the company manufactures aspirational, sustainable, and affordable homes using timber construction methods. GROPYUS is using scalable construction and manufacturing solutions to tap into a future market, boost Europe's strength in innovation, while also playing a substantial role in improving sustainability.

**About the Role**



You will be part of a highly collaborative product team working at the core of our manufacturing facility, transforming digital models into physical elements at scale.



Product Teams at GROPYUS own what they build, including underlying infrastructure, build pipelines, automated testing, release and rollout management, monitoring, and support. You will bring your experience in working with PLCs and/or other OT systems like e.g. robots, into the team.



As a Software Engineer (PLC / OT), you will work with your team on evolving the rather traditional architecture of MES like systems integrating via OPC\-UA with PLCs into a future\-proof architecture built with **Software Defined Manufacturing** in mind. You should be looking forward to developing less PLC / OT code over time and building a solution that allows for full **simulation** of upcoming manufacturing orders.



Furthermore, our teams are also responsible for operating and troubleshooting the software they have developed during working hours of the factory.


**What you'll be doing**



As a Software Engineer (f/m/d) on the Product Delivery team, you will be responsible for:


* **Understanding and explaining** the existing PLC / OT code base from our vendor to the rest of your team.
* Working together with your team and other teams in Product Delivery to **evolve** the current architecture into a truly **Software Defined Manufacturing** setup.
* Bringing an o**perational mindset** to monitor, maintain, and improve software uptime including reliable updates, latency, and efficiency
* Acting as a bridge between digital product delivery \& physical logistics and manufacturing systems, ensuring both are aligned and integrated
* Helping define, monitor and evolve **SLAs/SLOs** as well as other important KPIs like e.g. OEE for critical systems


**What you bring**


* You are an experienced software / automation engineer with experience in **PLC** or other **OT** technologies
* You are willing and excited to adopt modern software engineering approaches like code reviews, testing, CI/CD, etc.
* You have operated and supported large\-scale software / OT systems
* You have worked in companies with **strong operational cultures**, ideally in logistics or manufacturing – understanding the commercial impact of system downtime
* You are proficient with most of the following technologies:
* + PLC programming (TIA19 is a plus)
	+ Robot programming (KRL is a plus)
	+ OPC\-UA
	+ MQTT is a plus
	+ Python / C\+\+ / C\# is a plus
* You are familiar with monitoring and alerting practices for production systems
* You have experience defining and working with SLAs/SLOs
* You are willing to travel to our manufacturing site in Richen whenever needed and within Germany and Austria for in\-person team events

**What We Offer**
-----------------


* An **unlimited** contract with 30 vacation days.
* **Flexible, hybrid work:** You can work from home or come into the office on the schedule that works best for you. Feel like traveling and working from another location? No problem. Tune into meetings and work from abroad for up to 40 days per year. In addition, flex hours allow you to prioritize important moments in your day.
* **Attractive perks and benefits**: We offer a company pension scheme, language courses (English/German), and employee discounts with selected sustainable brands. Furthermore, our external partners in mental health support you in strengthening your mental health through anonymous private/group sessions.
* **Virtual Shares Program**: Participate in the success of GROPYUS through our Virtual Share Program.
* **Ownership**: You can truly make your mark with your work and contributions – on all our organizational levels. Find your solutions, drive and test them.
* **The chance to be part of something big**: Our mission is to rethink an entire industry. Join us in reinventing construction and fostering sustainable, affordable living.
* **A diverse and enriching work environment**: Become a valued member of a wonderfully diverse team of individuals from over 50 countries. At GROPYUS we value inclusion above all, ensuring that everyone feels they belong – no matter their background. In this way, our differences become strengths that help us grow as a team.

#### **Join us on our mission to design buildings as continuously evolving products to create the most exciting and affordable experience for all. We build for people and conserve the resources of our planet.**

**We can't wait to get to know you.**
**For more information, visit our** **website****.**

jobs.title: Application Security Engineer
jobs.description:
#### **Your mission**


As our Application Security Engineer, you will play a key role in shaping and strengthening the security of our products and platforms. Working closely with highly skilled engineering, platform, and security teams, you will help build secure, resilient, and trusted software while driving a security\-first culture across the organization. This is an opportunity to make a measurable impact on modern products, influence security strategy, and continuously develop your expertise in a collaborative and innovative environment.

* Drive product security across the entire software development lifecycle (SDLC).
* Perform threat modeling, architecture reviews, and security assessments for applications, APIs, and distributed systems.
* Identify, assess, prioritize, and support the remediation of security vulnerabilities.
* Integrate, operate, and continuously improve security tooling within CI/CD pipelines, including SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency scanning, and secrets\-scanning solutions.
* Define, promote, and support secure coding standards and security best practices across engineering teams.
* Review and advise on authentication, authorization, identity management, secrets management, and service\-to\-service communication designs.
* Support penetration testing activities, conduct targeted security testing, and drive remediation efforts.
* Contribute to security policies, standards, and security awareness initiatives.
* Partner closely with software engineers, architects, and platform teams to embed security into development processes and strengthen our DevSecOps culture.

#### **Your profile**

* 5\+ years of experience in Product Security, Application Security, Software Security, Secure Software Development, or a related field.
* Strong understanding of secure software development practices and common application security vulnerabilities.
* Proven experience performing threat modeling, architecture reviews, code reviews, and application security assessments.
* Hands\-on experience with SAST, DAST, SCA, dependency\-scanning, and secrets\-scanning tools.
* Strong knowledge of application security, API security, and distributed\-system security.
* Experience securing authentication, authorization, and identity\-related workflows.
* Solid understanding of OWASP, CWE, security testing methodologies, and modern security engineering practices.
* Experience working with CI/CD pipelines and applying DevSecOps principles.
* Ability to collaborate effectively with software engineering, platform, and DevOps teams.
* Fluent English skills are required; German language skills are a plus.

**Nice to have**  

* Development experience in C\#, .NET, JavaScript/TypeScript, Python, or similar programming languages.
* Experience securing cloud\-native applications and services in Azure and/or AWS environments.
* Relevant security certifications such as OSCP, CSSLP, OSWE, or GIAC Secure Development certifications.
* Experience working in agile software development environments.

#### **Why us?**

**Modernes, zentral gelegenes Büro:** Nur 5 Gehminuten von der Haltestelle Bahrenfeld entfernt \- bequeme Anreise garantiert!  

  

**Offene Unternehmenskultur:** Tauche ein in ein internationales Arbeitsumfeld, in dem Ideen und Vielfalt gefördert werden.  

  

**Kollegiale Arbeitsatmosphäre:** Genieße eine Arbeitsatmosphäre, die von Zusammenarbeit und Hands\-on\-Mentalität geprägt ist.  

  

**Hybrides Arbeitsmodell:** Flexibilität \- Kombiniere Arbeit vor Ort und im Home Office.  

  

**30 Tage Urlaub:** Mehr Zeit für Erholung und Freizeit. Zusätzliche freie Tage am 24\.12\., 31\.12\. sowie einen halben Tag an deinem Geburtstag.  

  

**Attraktives Vergütungspaket:** Wir honorieren deine Leistung angemessen.  

  

**Betriebliche Altersvorsorge:** Mit großzügigem 25% Arbeitgeber\-Zuschuss bis zu 75 €.  

  

**Pluxee\-Gutscheine:** Für unbeschwerte Verpflegung während der Arbeit.  

  

**HVV\-Abo\- oder Tiefgaragenstellplatz\-Zuschuss:** Unterstützung für Deine bequeme  

  

**JobRad:** Nutze die Möglichkeit, nach der Probezeit ein JobRad zu leasen.  

  

**EGYM Wellpass:** Nutze die Möglichkeit, nach der Probezeit dich körperlich und mental fit zu halten.

#### **About us**


Telio is a medium\-sized, internationally active, rapidly growing company in the field of telecommunications and IT services in the prison sector. As the European market leader, we have been providing communications solutions for prisons and their inmates worldwide for over 25 years. With more than 300 employees, we are active in 23 countries and develop, install and operate communication and media systems that make an important contribution to resocialization in prisons as well as in correctional facilities.

jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

* Im Backend verfügst Du über tiefe Praxis mit ASP.NET Core Web APIs und Microsoft SQL Server oder PostgreSQL. REST\-basierte Architekturen, saubere API\-Schnitte sowie ein solides Verständnis für Datenmodelle und Performance sind für Dich selbstverständlich.
* Teile unserer Cloud\-Services betreiben wir in Azure. Du hast idealerweise produktive Erfahrung mit Microsoft Azure und verstehst Cloud\-Infrastruktur im Allgemeinen. Nicht nur als Deployment\-Ziel, sondern, im Sinne von DevOps, als Teil der Architektur, die Du mit gestaltest und betreibst.
* Qualitätssicherung ist fester Bestandteil Deiner Arbeit: testgetriebene Entwicklung, Komponenten\-, Integrations\- und End\-to\-End\-Tests sind für Dich gute und geübte Praxis.
* Boilerplate\-Code lässt Du gerne von AI erledigen, z.B. von GitHub Copilot oder Claude Code – mit klarem Blick auf Codequalität, Wartbarkeit und Verantwortung.
* Du kommunizierst offen und zugewandt, gibst konstruktiven Rat und forderst aktiv Hilfe ein, wenn es mal schwierig wird.
* Stillstand ist nichts für Dich. Du hast Lust auf Neues – in Technologien, fachlichen Domänen und Denkweisen.

 **Dein Fundament:**

* **Dein Background:** Du hast ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium (Informatik oder vergleichbar) in der Tasche.
* **Dein Track\-Record:** Du blickst auf mindestens 4 Jahre echte Berufserfahrung in der Softwareentwicklung zurück.
* **Deine Base:** Da wir eng im Team und direkt mit unseren Kunden zusammenarbeiten, kommunizierst Du sicher und fließend auf Deutsch und Englisch.
* **Deine Location:** Du wohnst in der Nähe von Bochum oder bist umzugsbereit, denn Präsenz an mindestens 3 Tagen pro Woche bei uns im Büro ist für unser Miteinander essenziell.

**Dein Tech\-Stack \& Mindset:**

* **Full\-Stack aus Überzeugung:** Du bewegst dich im gesamten Stack sicher und bringst ein tiefes analytisches Denken mit.
* **Architektur \& Konzepte:** RESTful APIs, relationale Datenbanken und gängige Design Patterns sind Dein tägliches Handwerkszeug. Dein klarer Fokus liegt auf zukunftsfähiger Software\-Architektur.
* **Qualitäts\-Enthusiast:** Clean Code ist für Dich kein Buzzword, sondern Lebenseinstellung. Code\-Audits und Refactorings gehören für Dich ganz natürlich dazu.
* **Cloud \& Mobile:** Du hast Erfahrung mit den Architekturen von SaaS\-Lösungen und mobilen Anwendungen, idealerweise im CNCF\-Kontext (Cloud Native Computing Foundation).
* **Performance\-Profi:** Du weißt genau, wie man Systeme skalierbar baut. Exponentielles Wachstum schreckt Dich nicht ab, weil Du fundiertes Wissen über Performance\-Optimierungen und ETL\-Prozesse besitzt.
* **AI\-Ready:** Du weißt KI\-Tools in der Softwareentwicklung nicht nur zu schätzen, sondern setzt sie bereits gezielt und sinnvoll ein, um Workflows zu optimieren.
* **Mentor \& Lerner:** Du hast Bock auf lebenslanges Lernen und teilst Dein Wissen genauso gerne. Mentoring von Kolleginnen und Kollegen ist für Dich Ehrensache.

jobs.title: .NET Full-Stack Developer
jobs.description:
Bromcom is a leading provider of cloud\-based software solutions for the education sector. We develop innovative Management Information Systems (MIS), Finance and Analytics solutions that support schools, Multi\-Academy Trusts (MATs) and Local Authorities across the UK.


Our mission is to transform the way educational organisations work by providing secure, intuitive and innovative technology that helps schools operate more efficiently and enables educators to focus on what matters most – delivering outstanding outcomes for children and young people.


As Bromcom continues to grow, we are investing in our people, products and technology to support our ambitious plans for the future. This is an exciting opportunity to join a growing technology team and play a key role in developing and enhancing solutions used by education organisations across the UK.

**The Role**


The .NET Full\-Stack Developer is responsible for developing, maintaining and enhancing web applications across both backend and frontend technologies.


Working as part of a collaborative development team, the role will contribute to the design and delivery of reliable, scalable and maintainable software solutions. The successful candidate will have a solid foundation in full\-stack development, with particular experience in .NET and C\#, alongside the ability and enthusiasm to learn and work with new technologies as required.


The role will also involve using AI\-assisted development tools to support software development, including code generation, troubleshooting, testing and productivity. The successful candidate will be comfortable working alongside AI tools while applying their own technical knowledge and judgement to review, validate and refine AI\-generated outputs.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop, maintain and enhance web applications across both backend and frontend components.
* Develop reliable and scalable backend services and APIs using .NET and C\#.
* Contribute to frontend development using modern web technologies and frameworks.
* Use AI\-assisted development tools to support coding, debugging, testing, research and problem\-solving.
* Review, validate and refine AI\-generated code and recommendations, applying sound technical judgement and development standards.
* Write clean, maintainable and well\-tested code in line with agreed development standards.
* Troubleshoot technical issues, identify root causes and implement effective solutions.
* Participate in code reviews, testing and debugging activities to maintain high standards of software quality.
* Work collaboratively with Business Analysts, Developers, QA and other stakeholders throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of development processes, practices and technical solutions.
* Quickly learn and apply new technologies, tools, frameworks and AI\-assisted development approaches where required.
* Support the delivery of high\-quality software within agreed timescales.

**Skills \& Experience**

**Essential**

* Practical experience in full\-stack software development.
* Strong working knowledge of .NET and C\#.
* Experience developing web applications and backend services/APIs.
* Understanding of frontend development and modern web technologies.
* Good understanding of software development principles and practices.
* Experience troubleshooting, debugging and resolving technical issues.
* Ability to write clean, maintainable and well\-tested code.
* Experience or demonstrated ability to work effectively with AI\-assisted development tools, using them to support coding, debugging, testing and problem\-solving.
* Ability to critically review and validate AI\-generated code and suggestions, ensuring outputs are secure, accurate, maintainable and aligned with development standards.
* Strong underlying software development fundamentals, with the ability to understand, adapt and take ownership of AI\-assisted outputs.
* Experience working collaboratively within a software development team.
* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to learn new technologies and frameworks quickly.

**Desirable**

* Experience using AI\-assisted development tools such as Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot or similar tools.
* Working within an Agile software development environment.
* Experience with automated testing and/or test\-driven development.
* Experience with modern frontend frameworks and technologies.
* Experience participating in code reviews and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Personal Attributes**

* Curious and adaptable – keen to learn new technologies and develop their technical knowledge.
* AI\-aware and forward\-thinking – open to adopting AI\-assisted development tools while applying sound technical judgement to ensure they are used effectively and responsibly.
* A strong problem solver – able to investigate issues logically and identify practical solutions.
* Collaborative – comfortable working with developers, QA, Business Analysts and wider stakeholders.
* Quality focused – takes pride in producing reliable, maintainable and well\-tested code.
* Proactive – willing to contribute ideas and look for opportunities to improve processes and solutions.
* A strong communicator – able to explain technical issues and work effectively with both technical and non\-technical colleagues.

jobs.title: Overhead Line (OHL) Engineer – Ireland (Energy)
jobs.description:
**What if you could shape a career as unique as you?**

At WSP, you can always find opportunities to grow and do what matters to you. Make the most of our global reach to discover new challenges and chances to work with diverse, talented individuals who will help you expand your horizons.


**A little more about your role…**

Ireland is playing a critical role in delivering the future energy network.


Significant investment is being made in transmission infrastructure across the country, with major reinforcement programmes, new connections for renewable generation and strategic network upgrades helping to support Net Zero ambitions. Overhead line infrastructure will be central to this transformation, and WSP is supporting many of the projects that will shape the next generation of the UK's electricity network.


As a Senior Overhead Line Engineer, you will join a growing team delivering complex transmission projects across Ireland and the wider. Working from our Belfast, Nass or Dublin offices, you will provide technical leadership on projects ranging from network reinforcement schemes through to major new transmission connections supporting offshore wind, renewable energy and grid infrastructure developments.


You will work closely with multidisciplinary teams across engineering, environmental, planning and project delivery disciplines, helping clients develop and deliver safe, efficient and sustainable overhead line solutions.


This is an opportunity to play a leading role in some of the most significant energy infrastructure projects currently being developed across Ireland, while helping to grow and strengthen WSP's overhead line capability in the region.


**Why join our Ireland Energy Networks team?**

* **Help Deliver Ireland's Energy Transition** : Play a key role in developing the transmission infrastructure required to connect renewable generation and support the UK's journey to Net Zero.
* **Work on Major Infrastructure Projects** : Contribute to high\-profile overhead line projects ranging from 11kV to 400kV, supporting network operators, developers and major energy clients.
* **Build Local Capability** : Be part of WSP's continued investment in Ireland, helping to grow a strong local overhead line engineering capability.
* **Technical Leadership Opportunities** : Share your expertise, mentor engineers and contribute to the development of best practice across a growing team.
* **Multidisciplinary Collaboration** : Work alongside specialists in substations, power systems, cables, environmental services, planning and asset management.
* **Professional Development** : Access structured development programmes, mentoring, Chartership support and opportunities to progress into technical, project or people leadership roles.
* **Flexible and Hybrid Working** : Balance local office collaboration with flexible working arrangements that support both project delivery and personal wellbeing.

**This is an excellent opportunity to…**

Join a growing overhead line engineering team delivering some of the most strategically important electricity transmission projects, with particular focus on Ireland's expanding transmission network.


* Lead and support the delivery of overhead line engineering and design activities across transmission and distribution projects ranging from 11kV to 400kV.
* Provide technical leadership, guidance and mentoring to engineers within multidisciplinary project teams.
* Prepare technical reports, design documentation, specifications and engineering proposals to support project development and delivery.
* Undertake overhead line design activities including route development, PLS\-CADD modelling, structure spotting, clearance assessments, structure loading, conductor and insulator selection and line optimisation studies.
* Carry out sag\-tension calculations, blowout assessments, swing angle studies and other technical analyses required for overhead line design.
* Support feasibility studies and option assessments to identify technically preferred solutions for clients and stakeholders.
* Provide technical input during stakeholder engagement, statutory planning processes and public consultation activities.
* Review engineering deliverables and ensure designs comply with industry standards, client requirements and applicable regulations.
* Support project delivery through design reviews, technical assurance processes and quality management activities.
* Contribute to the development of innovative engineering solutions that improve performance, reduce risk and enhance constructability.
Actively contribute to technical excellence initiatives and industry forums, helping to shape the future of overhead line engineering.  
* 

**What we will be looking for you to demonstrate…**

* Degree qualified in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Civil Engineering, Power Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
* Demonstrable experience in the design and delivery of overhead transmission line projects up to 400kV.
* Strong understanding of overhead line design principles, including structure spotting, route optimisation, conductor selection, clearance assessments and line performance requirements.
* Experience supporting major transmission infrastructure projects, grid reinforcement schemes, renewable energy connections or wider energy network developments.
* Experience of conductor upgrade projects, including the application of High Temperature Low Sag (HTLS) conductor technologies and network optimisation solutions.
* Working knowledge of industry design standards, utility requirements and engineering best practice relating to overhead transmission systems.
* Experience using industry\-standard design tools such as PLS\-CADD, PLS\-TOWER and PLS\-POLE would be highly advantageous.
* Knowledge of advanced technical studies including conductor galloping assessments, EMF and field effects calculations, acoustic assessments, wake effects and AC interference studies would be beneficial.
* Ability to provide technical leadership and act as a trusted advisor to clients, project managers and engineering teams.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence technical discussions and build strong working relationships.
* Experience supporting or participating in technical committees, working groups and professional organisations such as CIGRE, IEEE or IET would be advantageous.
* Chartered Engineer status (CEng), or a demonstrable commitment towards achieving professional registration.
* Willingness to travel occasionally to project sites and client locations across Ireland, the UK and internationally where required.
A passion for helping shape Ireland's future energy network and contributing to the continued growth of WSP's overhead line engineering capability.  
* 

Don’t quite meet all the criteria? Apply, and we can see how your experience aligns to this role and other opportunities within the team.


**Imagine a better future for you and a better future for us all.**

Work on landmark projects around the world and embrace opportunities to make an even bigger impact in the communities you care about. What if you could do the best work of your life and create a legacy for yourself?


**With us, you can. Apply today.**

**\#LI\-TD1**


  
We are one of the world’s leading engineering and professional services firms. Our passionate people are united by the common purpose of creating positive, long\-lasting impacts on the communities we serve through a culture of innovation, integrity, and inclusion. With over 11,000 professionals across the UK and Ireland, we are dedicated to our local communities and propelled by international brainpower.


**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU?**

**Work\-life balance**

At WSP, we understand that work is just one aspect of your life. It’s important to make time for you, your family, friends, interests and your community.


Our hybrid working policy offers the flexibility to work from home two days a week, while also providing opportunities to collaborate in our modern offices across the UK.


**Inclusivity \& Belonging**

We welcome applicants with varied backgrounds and experiences. We enable rewarding careers by encouraging people to bring their whole and authentic selves to work so that our work represents the fullest spectrum of society. We celebrate integrity and treat people with respect, supporting each other and embracing a culture of inclusion and belonging at WSP. We have our employee resource groups bring together employees and allies with different backgrounds to promote a culture of inclusivity.


**Health \& Wellbeing**

We are committed to supporting our people, giving you the tools to make improvements to your health and wellbeing through our Thrive programme.


Our Virtual GP service gives you access to an NHS or Irish Medical Council GP at a time and place that suits you – giving you peace of mind and quick access to medical advice when you need it most. We also provide reasonable workplace adjustments for those in need. Working from our offices, you will join a growing team of specialists that combines local Irish knowledge with the scale and technical expertise of WSP's wider Energy business.


This is an opportunity to work on some of the most significant energy infrastructure projects currently being developed across Ireland, while helping to shape and grow a long\-term cable engineering capability in the region.

jobs.title: Electrical Engineer II (Integrations)
jobs.description:
Help us use technology to make a big green dent in the universe!


Kraken powers some of the most innovative global developments in energy.


We create the technology that redefines utilities and unlocks a new energy system of the future. By optimising renewable generation, building a more intelligent grid, and empowering utilities to deliver an exceptional customer experience, our operating system is transforming the industry worldwide.


It’s an incredibly exciting time to work in energy. Join us on our mission to improve the lives of ONE BILLION humans within the decade and shape a cleaner, better future for everyone.

**Kraken Generation Flex**
--------------------------


The energy industry is undergoing the largest transformation since industrialisation, at an unprecedented rate of change and we are positioning ourselves at the heart of it. In the UK, with a legally binding Net Zero target for 2050 and a clean\-power ambition for 2030, we are scaling rapidly to integrate Distributed Energy Resources (DERs) into the grid.


Kraken is recognised as a thought leader and innovator. With complete independence from Octopus Energy, we are building a SaaS business that digitally connects hundreds of thousands of DERs with energy markets. As our UK fleet grows and we support our expansion across Europe, we are looking for an Integrations Engineer to help turn customer sites into market\-connected, controllable assets.

**Where you’ll fit in and role summary**
----------------------------------------


As we scale our fleet of integrated assets, we are looking for an Electrical Engineer to support the delivery of our site integrations and grow into owning them, learning the full lifecycle from the early information stage through design, deployment and testing.


You’ll be part of an engineering delivery team, based in Manchester, who take an integration project from the very early information stage, design how it will be integrated into Kraken’s platform and then turn that design into a live, controllable, market\-participating asset.


Engineering delivery is an innovative and engineering\-focused team with a culture that fosters collaboration and fresh thinking to create a new energy system. Alongside design, deployment and testing; they constantly look into ways to improve efficiency through tooling and the automation of repetitive tasks. They collaborate daily with delivery managers and customer success to onboard new sites as well as support the existing.

**What you'll own**
-------------------

* **Integration design contribution:** With guidance, analyse provided information and contribute to hardware and software integration approaches. When necessary, exchange information with customer technical representatives through meetings and emails, and take part in design discussions with other team members.
* **Technical judgement:** Develop your technical judgement, making well\-reasoned decisions and trade\-offs with support from senior engineers, and contributing technical input to discussions within the team.
* **Developing domain knowledge:** Build up your knowledge in one or more technical areas. This could include grid regulations (G99, G100, Grid Code etc.), energy markets, multi BMUs, industrial communication protocols, industrial networking, internet of things, cyber security and so on.
* **Gateway application \& configuration:** Learn how the Gateway software (developed by an internal software team) works and how it is configured. Understand the requirements for an integration and judge if the gateway software is able to support it or will need new development work. The team will help you get gateway configuration literate and you will carry out deployments and changes independently over time.
* **Hardware and Software Deployments:** Learn the process of our hardware and software deployments. Over time, take ownership of the configuration, deployment and testing with guidance from the senior engineers.
* **Networking and cyber security:** Contribute to hardware and network connectivity designs, keeping our own cyber security posture in mind as well as addressing the concerns from customers, with the support of the internal security team.
* **Site testing \& commissioning:** Carry out site testing and commissioning initially with the support of the team and building toward doing this independently as onboarding demand grows.
* **Incidents \& compliance:** Help address engineering help requests from other teams and support incident response in the case of issues at existing sites.

**What you'll bring to the party**
----------------------------------

* **Understanding of the Regulations:** Working knowledge of the UK Grid Code, G99 and the other obligations of a grid\-connected asset before it can participate in the energy markets.
* **Understanding of the UK Energy Markets:** Working understanding of the NESO ancillary services (Dynamic Containment / Moderation / Regulation, Firm Frequency Response), the Balancing Mechanism, and the DNO connection/integration process.
* **Technical judgement:** Sound technical judgement and a structured approach to problems, working with the team to agree and implement a solution.
* **Power plant systems:** Ability to read and analyse single line diagrams for a given power plant to understand the site architecture for the points of metering and control instrumentation.
* **Asset integration:** Exposure to, or a keen interest in, integrating BESS (grid\-scale and/or C\&I) and/or RES (Wind and Solar) for telemetry and control.
* **Integration design:** Ability to contribute to clear integration designs and design documentation.
* **Hardware and Networking:** Familiarity with control systems deployments and their connectivity including the local networking and cyber security aspects, and an ability to help debug site connectivity and networking issues (including 4G routers and firewalls) with support.
* **Industrial Communication Protocols:** Practical experience or a good working knowledge of Modbus (TCP/RTU); awareness of one or more of IEC 60870\-5\-104, IEC 61400\-25, OPC\-UA or DNP3 is a plus.
* **CAD, Diagrams and Tools:** Experience or familiarity with CAD tools such as AutoCAD or BricsCAD, Miro and Notion.
* **Communication:** A clear communicator who documents their work (e.g. in design docs and Notion) and collaborates well with the team.
* **Commissioning landscape:** Awareness of the other parties involved in site commissioning for power plants, their roles and responsibilities, and how we work with them.
* **Engineering background:** Bachelor's in Electrical Engineering, Automation/Control, Software, or a related field \- or equivalent practical experience in industrial/energy integration.
* **A proactive and collaborative mindset:** You are eager to learn and grow, reliable and collaborative. You take initiative, communicate openly, raise risks early, and care about safe working. You welcome feedback, support your teammates, and steadily build toward taking on more independent ownership of integrations over time.
* **Travel:** Willingness to travel to customers and sites although travel is very occasional. Awareness of site safety is required as we may work with site personnel even though we are remote.

**️ Bonus points**
------------------

* Wider knowledge of grid compliance (G99, G100, Grid Code) and where the Kraken system fits in.
* Experience with AWS IoT Greengrass or similar edge\-deployment architectures.
* Familiarity with software/scripting and templating (e.g. Python, Rust, the Linux command line) and Git\-based workflows.
* Understanding of IT/OT security in the energy sector (IEC 62443, NIS Regulations awareness).
* Exposure to wider European balancing markets / ENTSO\-E frameworks and TSO integrations.

*Are you ready for a career with us? We want to ensure you have the right tools and environment to unleash your potential. If you have any accommodation requests, please contact us at inclusion@kraken.tech. We’ll do our best to tailor the experience to your needs so you can feel comfortable, confident and be at your best!*

*Studies have shown that some groups of people, like women, are less likely to apply to a role unless they meet 100% of the job requirements. Whoever you are, if you like one of our jobs, we encourage you to apply as you might just be the candidate we’re looking for! At Kraken, we're creating a team of genuine, honest, empathetic people. Our people are our strongest asset and the unique skills and perspectives people bring to the team are the driving force of our success. As an equal opportunity employer, we do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute. We consider all applicants without regard to race, colour, religion, national origin, age, sex, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.*

* Our (i) Applicant and Candidate Privacy Notice and Artificial Intelligence (AI) Notice, (ii) Website Privacy Notice and (iii) Cookie Notice govern the collection and use of your personal data in connection with your application and use of our website. These policies explain how we handle your data and outline your rights under applicable laws, including, but not limited to, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Depending on your location, you may have the right to access, correct, or delete your information, object to processing, or withdraw consent. By applying, you acknowledge that you’ve read, understood and consent to these terms


Please note that, in line with our current recruitment policy, we are unable to offer visa sponsorship for this position; applicants must have the right to work in the country that they're applying to, at the time of application.\*

jobs.title: Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Autonomy)
jobs.description:
UFORCE exists to make aggression unaffordable.  

  

Founded in Ukraine and headquartered in London, UFORCE is a defence\-technology company with operations across Europe, the United States and Asia.  

  

UFORCE builds uncrewed vessels, ground robotics and aircraft, autonomy software, and the command\-and\-control layer that operates them together. Each platform is deployable on its own, and stronger as part of the system. Its product lines include the MAGURA family of uncrewed surface vessels, the NEMESIS family of strike platforms, the LIUT family of ground robotic platforms, and counter\-UAS systems.

**About the role**


The Senior/Staff Software Engineer (Autonomy) will design, build, and operate software capabilities that improve the mission effectiveness and safety of uncrewed surface vehicles across the UFORCE C2/C4ISR stack.


This role spans **Perception Autonomy, Autonomy Behaviours**—including collision avoidance (COLAV), target\-based manoeuvring and engagement—and **Swarm Intelligence**. You will take cross\-system initiatives from design and implementation through scenario\-based verification, field trials, deployment, and iteration.


The role requires strong software engineering and mathematical foundations, with an emphasis on autonomy that remains safe, observable, and useful in real operating conditions—including degraded sensors, different sea states, and GNSS\- or RF\-challenged environments.

### **What you’ll do**

* Build production\-grade capabilities across perception, autonomous behaviours, COLAV, and multi\-USV coordination.
* Define measurable acceptance criteria for autonomy performance, safety, reliability, and operator trust.
* Validate perception and behaviours across day/night operations, different sea states, sensor degradation, and GNSS/RF\-challenged conditions.
* Develop swarm capabilities such as task allocation, role assignment, formation control, and distributed sensing.
* Build scenario libraries, replay tooling, automated metrics, and CI gates to prevent regressions.
* Introduce structured logging, playback, and failure classification to accelerate field diagnosis.
* Build operator controls and safeguards that enable crews to use autonomy without continuous engineering support.
* Collaborate with platform, C2, product, and field teams to define clear interfaces and deliver cross\-system capabilities.

### **What success looks like**

* Perception and COLAV meet agreed performance and safety criteria in representative trials.
* Swarm capabilities are used routinely in multi\-USV exercises and degrade safely under constraints.
* Operators can configure and use autonomy without day\-to\-day engineering intervention.
* Automated scenario testing prevents safety and reliability regressions.
* Field failures can be reproduced and diagnosed within an agreed timeframe.
* Capabilities have documented operating envelopes, limitations, and evidence of field readiness.

### **Required qualifications**

* 8\+ years of production software or backend engineering experience.
* Strong experience with **Java, Python, or .NET/C\#**.
* Strong mathematical foundations relevant to autonomy and robotics.
* Experience with distributed, real\-time, event\-driven, or mission\-critical systems.
* Understanding of sockets, UDP, latency, packet loss, and low\-level protocols.
* Strong testing, observability, debugging, and operational ownership.
* Clear communication and cross\-team collaboration skills.

### **Nice to have**

* Experience with **C\+\+, Rust, or C**.
* Experience with robotics, autonomous vehicles, maritime autonomy, or UxV systems.
* Knowledge of perception, sensor fusion, navigation, planning, or control systems.
* Experience with COLAV, simulation, replay tooling, or multi\-agent systems.
* Experience in defence, C2/C4ISR, or constrained operating environments.


The nature of combat has changed.


Tomorrow’s battlefield success depends on autonomy, speed, and adaptability.


And UFORCE is ready.


Are You?
