jobs.title: Multi Skilled Services Engineer (Mechanical)
jobs.description:
Chelsea and Westminster Hospital NHS Foundation Trust is looking for a skilled and motivated Multi Skilled Services Engineer (Plumber) to join our Estates and Facilities team. This is an excellent opportunity to play a key role in maintaining the engineering infrastructure that supports the delivery of outstanding patient care across our hospital sites.
  
  

The successful candidate will provide a comprehensive plumbing and mechanical maintenance service, carrying out planned preventative maintenance, reactive repairs, fault finding, testing, inspections, and installation work across a diverse healthcare estate. Working on a range of systems including domestic water services, pumps, pipework, sanitary systems, and mechanical plant, you will help ensure that essential services remain safe, reliable, and fully operational.
  
  

In return, we offer a supportive working environment, ongoing training and development opportunities, access to the NHS Pension Scheme, generous annual leave entitlement, and the opportunity to build a rewarding career within one of London's leading NHS Trusts.
  
  

If you are a dedicated plumbing professional looking for a varied and rewarding role where your work directly contributes to patient safety and operational excellence, we would be delighted to hear from you. Join us and help maintain the environments that enable exceptional care for our patients, visitors, and staff every day.
  
  

The postholder is responsible for delivering safe, effective, and compliant mechanical maintenance services across the Trust, ensuring all work is undertaken in accordance with statutory regulations, HTMs, British Standards, and Trust policies. The role includes managing planned and reactive maintenance through the CAFM system, maintaining accurate records, supporting audits and compliance activities, and contributing to the safe operation of critical engineering systems. The postholder will monitor performance, support continuous service improvements, participate in training and professional development, and promote high standards of health, safety, governance, and risk management. They will also support budgetary control through efficient use of resources, liaise with contractors and stakeholders, participate in the on\-call rota, and work flexibly across Trust sites as a multi\-skilled technician to ensure the delivery of reliable, patient\-focused Estates services.
  
  

Our Trust is one of England's top\-performing and safest trusts. We operate two main acute hospital sites—Chelsea and Westminster Hospital and West Middlesex University Hospital—along with award\-winning clinics across North West London.
  
  

Our nearly 7,500 staff care for a diverse population of 1\.5m, providing full clinical services including maternity, A\&E and children’s services, plus specialist HIV and sexual health care. The CQC rates us Good in safety, effectiveness, care and responsiveness, and Outstanding in leadership and resource use.
  
  

We continually invest in our facilities, including a £30m expansion of critical care at Chelsea and an £80m Ambulatory Diagnostic Centre at West Mid.
  
  

We are delivering sustainable healthcare through our Green Plan. In line with Greener NHS ambitions, we aim for net zero carbon emissions by 2045\. Achieving this requires collective effort. We encourage staff to reduce their impact on carbon, waste and pollution wherever possible. Every action counts to create a healthier, more sustainable future.
  
  

We are committed to equal opportunities and believe diversity drives innovation and excellence. We welcome applications from the global majority, veterans and underrepresented communities, valuing the perspectives they bring.
  
  

The postholder is responsible for providing a comprehensive, high\-quality mechanical engineering maintenance service across the Trust’s estate, ensuring that all plant, equipment and engineering systems are maintained in a safe, reliable and compliant condition to support the delivery of patient care. The role encompasses the planned and reactive maintenance of a wide range of mechanical systems, including heating, ventilation, water services, pressure systems, medical gases and other specialist infrastructure, ensuring compliance with all relevant statutory legislation, Health Technical Memoranda (HTMs), British Standards, Trust policies and industry best practice. The postholder will use the Trust’s CAFM system to manage, prioritise and record maintenance activities, ensuring accurate documentation of all works undertaken, compliance records, asset information and audit evidence. They will contribute to the achievement of regulatory compliance through participation in Planned Preventative Maintenance (PPM) programmes, inspections, audits, risk assessments and permit\-to\-work systems, while actively identifying, escalating and mitigating risks that may affect operational service delivery.
  
  

The role requires a strong commitment to quality, safety and continuous improvement, including monitoring equipment performance, analysing maintenance trends, supporting service improvement initiatives and contributing technical expertise to engineering projects and operational decision\-making. The postholder will maintain up\-to\-date professional knowledge through ongoing training and development, supporting the Trust’s compliance agenda and progression towards Competent Person, Responsible Person or Authorising Person status where appropriate. They will promote effective governance by adhering to all Health \& Safety requirements, safe systems of work and risk management procedures, while ensuring contractors and colleagues work in accordance with statutory obligations and Trust standards. In addition, the postholder will support efficient financial management through the effective use of resources, stock control, procurement support and the delivery of cost\-effective maintenance solutions.
  
  

Working as part of a multidisciplinary Estates team, the postholder will provide a flexible and responsive service across all Trust sites, participating in the on\-call rota and responding to emergency situations as required. They will liaise professionally with clinical teams, patients, visitors, contractors and colleagues, maintaining excellent communication and customer service standards at all times. The role requires the ability to operate as a multi\-skilled technician, undertaking a variety of engineering and non\-engineering maintenance tasks to support the wider Estates function, ensuring that the Trust’s buildings, infrastructure and critical services remain safe, compliant, operationally effective and fit for purpose.

jobs.title: IT Developer
jobs.description:
#### **Role Summary and Department Overview**

Peel Hunt is looking for an enthusiastic IT Developer with strong core Java skills, an interest in learning other technologies and a desire to work across a diverse business and technology stack.


The role sits within an experienced Development team of six and will work on a range of in\-house systems supporting real\-time equity trading, electronic market making, business workflow management and internal data analysis. The team is highly visible and delivers functionality across the firm.


The Development team has responsibility for its own working practices and operates a flat structure, with shared decision\-making and accountability. The role reports to the Head of Development and works closely with TechOps, Tech Programme Management, Data Technology and Analytics, and Systems across the wider IT department.

##### **Core Technology Environment**

* Java 25 server\-side applications, supported by Python for simpler scripts.
* React web applications, SQL Server databases and C\# native front ends.
* KDB time\-series storage and analysis.
* Informatica UltraMessaging and Chronicle\-based infrastructure.
* Influx and Grafana for system instrumentation and monitoring.
* Linux servers, including RHEL 9\.
* Development tools including IntelliJ, Rider, Git, JIRA/YouTrack and TeamCity.
* Experimental use of Claude Code.

#### **Responsibilities**

###### **Role Responsibilities:**

* Develop and deliver software solutions addressing a wide range of business problems.
* Work with stakeholders to understand their requirements and the wider problem, and determine the most appropriate solution.
* Ability to work both independently as well as collaboratively with other developers, depending on the scope and scale of the project.
* Plan and organise projects to deliver within appropriate timescales, adapting where priorities or relevant factors change.
* Ask for help when needed and support colleagues to ensure the team's outputs are functionally complete, performant and supportable.
* Work across greenfield development, extensions to existing applications, and day\-to\-day maintenance and enhancements.
* Provide second\-line support for the Development team's systems.

###### **Key Capabilities and Knowledge:**

* At least three years' server\-side development experience using core Java.
* Experience of high\-performance, distributed and multi\-threaded systems.
* Understanding of interfaces between, and separation of, interconnected modules and systems.
* Experience of front\-to\-back involvement in software development and delivery.
* Ability to break down complex problems into manageable phases.
* Commitment to delivering high\-quality code that minimises long\-term support and maintenance requirements.
* Experience of automated, unit and functional testing, with a pragmatic approach to the appropriate level of testing.
* Working knowledge of Linux.
* Ideally a 2:1 degree or higher in a technical discipline.

###### **Desirable experience:**

* React, which is a key technology for the team.
* SQL databases and queries, including Microsoft SQL Server, Oracle or Sybase.
* C\# GUI development.
* Python scripting or programming, potentially using libraries such as SciPy.
* KDB querying, management or maintenance.
* Chronicle, Influx or Grafana.
* Financial services experience is not essential. Strong technical capability, creativity and a desire to learn are valued more highly.

###### **Role Competencies:**

* Enthusiastic, curious and keen to learn new technologies and business areas.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Able to communicate effectively with technical colleagues and business stakeholders.
* Collaborative and willing both to learn from others and share knowledge.
* Organised, accountable and able to manage changing priorities.
* Pragmatic, with sound judgement about quality, performance, testing and supportability.
* Comfortable taking responsibility within a flat team structure.

###### **Other:**


This role is subject to the FCA Conduct Rules and the successful candidate will be required to comply with the standards of conduct expected under the Senior Managers and Certification Regime (SMCR).


We work on a hybrid basis, with three days a week in the office, while recognising the need for flexibility and balancing this with the requirements of the business.

##### **Line Management Responsibilities**


The role has no direct line management responsibilities. The role holder is expected to support colleagues, share knowledge and contribute to collective decision\-making within the Development team.

jobs.title: .NET Developer
jobs.description:
Over the past 30 years, we’ve grown from humble beginnings with a single computer into a diversified, global, technology\-enabled lottery and prize draw company (ASX: JIN). Today, Jumbo operates across Australia, the UK, Canada and the US, bringing together technology, creativity and purpose to create premium digital experiences people love.


Based in Galgate, StarVale is dedicated to strengthening the fundraising power of charities, not‑for‑profits, and hospices across the UK. We combine specialist lottery management with a genuine commitment to helping organisations maximise their impact, so more communities receive the support they deserve.

**What will you be doing?**


We’re looking for a .NET Web Developer to join us in this hands‑on build‑and‑migrate role. You will be rewriting existing PHP websites in .NET, integrating them with our business systems, and helping shape how we structure our shared architecture going forward. Working closely with cross‑functional teams, you will support day‑to‑day business needs, solve complex technical challenges, and contribute to high‑quality engineering practices through code reviews, documentation, and collaborative solution design.

**What Your Day\-to\-Day Will Look Like**


Your daily work will centre on maintaining, modernising, and progressively transforming our legacy .NET systems while supporting the smooth running of core business operations across StarVale. You can expect to:

* Design and build ASP.NET Core websites targeting modern .NET versions (including .NET 10\)
* Migrate Laravel and CodeIgniter sites to the .NET platform while preserving functionality, SEO, and data integrity
* Work with Umbraco CMS — extending existing implementations or building new sites where appropriate
* Integrate websites with core .NET business systems and SQL Server databases
* Write and maintain EF Core data access code, including migrating data from MySQL to SQL Server
* Document business logic and edge cases from existing PHP sites before decommissioning
* Contribute to shared architecture decisions, internal libraries, and coding standards
* Write clean, tested, maintainable code and participate in code reviews

**What You’ll Be Able to Bring to the Role**

**Essential**

* Solid commercial experience with C\# and ASP.NET Core (or strong ASP.NET MVC experience with a clear path to Core)
* Experience with Entity Framework Core (or EF) and relational databases (SQL Server)
* Comfortable working with front\-end fundamentals (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) alongside server\-rendered .NET views or Razor Pages
* Experience migrating or integrating systems between different platforms or frameworks
* Ability to read and understand PHP (Laravel and/or CodeIgniter) well enough to translate existing functionality into .NET — you won't be writing new PHP, but you'll need to understand what's there
* Good understanding of web fundamentals: routing, authentication, forms, SEO basics (URL structure, redirects)

**Mindset \& Soft Skills**

* Migration Mindset: Confidence to evaluate legacy code, challenge outdated practices, and guide non\-technical stakeholders through modernized technical solutions.
* Problem Solver: Highly resourceful with strong initiative, able to own projects independently from requirements\-gathering to deployment.
* Communication: Excellent people skills to liaise effectively between technical teams, external auditors, and cross\-departmental stakeholders.

**Preferred:**

* Experience with Umbraco CMS
* Experience with Blazor
* Familiarity with Azure or other cloud hosting for .NET applications
* Experience leading or contributing to a platform migration or legacy system modernization
* Understanding of REST API design, for connecting websites to internal business systems
* Ability to work within agile environments, including Kanban and Sprints.

**Salary Banding: £35,000–£45,000 per annum, depending on experience.**

 **Our Ways of Working**


At StarVale, we value balance and flexibility. You will be based in our office in Galgate, Lancaster. This role is a flexible hybrid, typically averaging 50% in the office (2\-3 days per week). We prioritise results and collaborate to make sure everyone can contribute effectively, while enjoying flexibility and balance in how they work.

**Why Join StarVale?**


Find Your Freedom \- https://bit.ly/Jumbointeractive


At StarVale, our team thrives because we invest in our people. Here’s what you can expect from us;

* An annual regional bonus scheme that rewards your contributions, dependent on company performance.
* 25 days annual leave \+ public holidays \+ your birthday off.
* Access to our Employee Assistance Program, providing counselling and coaching.
* Reward \& Recognition programme and length of service benefits.
* The freedom to work from almost anywhere in the world for up to 4 weeks a year.


Candidates who are offered a position will be required to complete pre\-employment checks through our partner, Checkmate, which will include referencing, Right to Work in the UK and DBS checks. We are, unfortunately, unable to offer sponsorship opportunities.

**We are a 2026 Circle Back Initiative Gold Employer – we commit to respond to every applicant.**

We are looking for an experienced Senior .NET Developer (C\#) to join the Acquisitions \& Originations engineering team within Experian's Credit \& Verification Services business.

**The Domain**


The Acquisitions \& Originations team develops and provides level 3 support for the Delphi Select and Evaluate platforms, which are used across the Acquisitions and Originations business. These are complex, configuration\-driven, multi\-client systems: each client (bank, lender or other financial institution) runs its own decisioning strategies, rules and data configurations on a shared codebase.


Clients depend on these systems to make real\-time lending and origination decisions, so reliability, data integrity and controlled release processes are central to the role.


This is a hybrid, Nottingham based role (40% in the office) reporting to the Lead Developer.

jobs.title: Senior Project Engineer
jobs.description:
Indra Park Air work with customers all over the globe to make air travel safer. For over 50 years we’ve been one of the leading producers of VHF and UHF radios, providing the vital link between the ground and the air for passenger, freight and military aircraft.


The reasons behind our success are simple and won’t change. First, we work harder for the customer than the rest. We take time to truly know their needs and create the right product for them. We train them how to use it, we won’t let our equipment be deployed until every detail is right, and then we provide the best care and service for all our products.


At Indra Park Air we stay the best by looking to the future – to new requirements and new possibilities. A radio remains a radio, but we never stop thinking about how we can improve it, and how it can offer more to our customers. It’s no wonder that we are one of only 2% of companies worldwide to hold PLATINUM Level in Investors in People Accreditation.


At Indra Park Air, our values guide everything we do, from developing industry\-leading technology to supporting our customers around the world.

**Innovation** \- Our capacity for innovation, cutting\-edge solutions, and specialised team of professionals enable us to drive a safer, more connected future through technology.

**Trust** \- We work with strength, commitment, and reliability, delivering quality solutions to build trust with customers, employees, partners, investors, and society.

**Connection** \- We harness the power of collaboration, connect ideas and solutions, and adapt to our customers' needs, supporting them on the path to a better future.

**Foresight** \- We anticipate future needs to make the world safer and more connected, transforming our experience and knowledge into solutions for a better tomorrow.


As **Senior Project Engineer** you coordinate and organise project activities and the development team to deliver internal and 3rd development project and report status.

**What you will do:**

* Ensure key documents are released and kept up to date, such as Project Quality Plan, Product Release Plan, Statement Of Work
* Work with the Project Lead to Plan and document project activities with support from Project Owner and Product Architect
* Identify human resource requirements
* Schedule activities to meet roadmap commitments. Track task completion and ensure tasks are kept upto date by engineers.
* Understand and document risks and their mitigations, with support from the technical team
* Liaise with the project Lead and team members to understand, monitor and report project status
* Assist the project Lead to deliver the project
* Support the generation and documentation of project requirements
* At the beginning of the project ensure all equipment required throughout the project is identified, and is available to the project team when it is needed
* Manage ordering of prototype PCBs, metalwork and other items ensuring these are available when needed
* Promptly escalate any issues preventing the team from achieving planned progress
* Organise appropriate review meetings and chair those delegated by the Product Engineering Manager
* Perform role of Project Engineer for several concurrent and/or large projects
* Manage and coordinate outsourced development projects with the 3rd party provider, reporting status, ensuring any internal dependencies are provided on time and loan equipment is arranged
* Drive the delivery of Project roadmap activities and support resource planning activities for the department managers.
* Support the department and department manager on related departmental activities.
* Keep internal stakeholders outside of Product Engineering up to date. Programme Management, Procurement and Operations.

**Accountabilities:**

* Work independently without guidance or direction
* Use best practices and knowledge of internal or external business issues to lead products/services or process improvements
* Identify, research, develop and drive forward ways of improving company technical performance
* Regularly monitor progress against goals and reorganise/rewrite plans to deal with change

**Commercial Awareness:**

* Understand how all engineering tasks impact non\-engineering internal and external customers

**Quality and Ethics:**

* Demonstrate flexibility and a positive attitude to changing priorities or direction
* Demonstrate excellent team working skills working collaboratively in own department, across the company and with external customers, suppliers and agencies
* Comply with company and departmental procedures
* Adopt a quality approach and foster a quality culture
* Contribute to process improvements
* Show the highest level of commitment to delivering exceptional customer service
* Understand and conform to the standards contained in the Company Standards of Business Ethics

  

**Requirements** **Qualifications**

* First\-class or upper\-second\-class (2:1\) degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant technical or engineering discipline.
* Strong academic background in Mathematics and Science, demonstrated through A Level or equivalent qualifications.

**Knowledge and/or practical experience in some of the following areas:**

* The full product development lifecycle, from concept and design through to verification, manufacture and product introduction.
* Project planning and management tools, such as MS Project, Jira or equivalent.
* MRP/ERP systems, such as SAP or equivalent.
* Communications and modulation techniques.
* Electronic circuit design, prototyping and development.
* Analogue, digital and RF electronics.
* FPGA design and firmware development.
* Software design and development methodologies.
* Embedded software design and implementation.
* Programming languages such as C, C\+\+, C\#, Python, HTML and JavaScript.
* Digital Signal Processing (DSP) techniques.
* Basic network technologies and communication protocols.
* Computer\-Aided Design (CAD) of mechanical parts and assemblies.
* Introduction of new products into a manufacturing environment.


Candidates are not expected to have experience in every area listed above; a broad technical foundation and the ability to develop knowledge in new areas are important.

**Work Experience**

* Previous experience in a design engineering or product development role.
* Experience working as part of a multidisciplinary engineering team would be advantageous.

**Personal Skills and Abilities**

* Strong interpersonal, communication and negotiation skills.
* Ability to communicate clearly and effectively with a range of internal and external stakeholders.
* Ability to plan ahead, identify potential issues and take appropriate action to support long\-term project objectives.
* Strong organisational and prioritisation skills, with the ability to manage competing tasks and deliver against project objectives.
* Highly self\-motivated, adaptable and positive, with a willingness to take ownership of tasks and responsibilities.
* Practical, hands\-on approach to engineering and problem solving.
* Customer\-focused, with an understanding of customer requirements and the ability to develop effective engineering solutions.

  

**Benefits**  

* Flexitime and core hours – 37\.5 hrs a week, core hrs between 0930\-1500
* Enhanced Holiday – 25 days plus bank holidays
* Enhanced Pension Scheme – up to 8% company contribution
* Life Assurance
* Liberty Days \- you can request up to 3 days of your annual leave ‘on the day’
* Buying and Selling Holidays
* Long service and retirement awards
* Private healthcare
* Flu vaccinations
* Cycle to work scheme
* Subsidised staff canteen
* Free parking
* Training
* Continuous Learning

jobs.title: Informatica Test Engineer X3
jobs.description:
On behalf of DWP, we are looking for X3 Informatica Test Engineers for a 12 month (Inside IR35\) contract based Hybrid in Either Blackpool, Leeds, Newcastle or Birmingham office.
  
  

The Department for Work and Pensions (DWP) is responsible for welfare, pensions, and child maintenance policy. As the UK’s biggest public service department, it administers the State Pension and a range of working age, disability and ill health benefits to around 20 million claimants and customers. As such, we operate on a scale that is almost unmatched anywhere in Europe and most people in Britain come into contact with us at some point in their lives.
  
  

Working with DWP, you will be helping us to drive our priorities to:
  
* Help people to move into work and support those already in work to progress, with the aim of increasing overall workforce participation
* Help people to plan and save for later life, while providing a safety net for those who need it now
* Provide effective, efficient, and innovative services to the millions of claimants who rely on us every day, including the most vulnerable in society
* Improve experience of our services while maximising value for money for the taxpayer.


As a Informatica Test Engineer, your main responsibilities will be:
  
* Review business requirements, functional specifications, and define appropriate test conditions.
* Execute test scripts, test scenarios, and test cases across various test stages.
* Facilitate test planning, estimation, and risk assessment activities.
* Perform defect management, triage, investigation, and support resolution activities.
* Produce clear and concise test reports for stakeholders and senior management.
* Validate source\-to\-target mappings, data transformations, reconciliation, and data migration activities.
* Design and create synthetic test data to validate data quality, business rules, mappings, and ETL processes.
* Experience identifying, analysing, and resolving data quality issues including completeness, accuracy, consistency, and integrity.


**Essential:**  

* Strong SQL and database knowledge, particularly Oracle and data warehouse structures
* Experience testing Informatica PowerCenter or Informatica Intelligent Cloud Services (IICS) data integration solutions.
* Experience testing SAS data pipelines, batch processes, and data transformations.
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT testing methodologies and data warehouse testing principles.
* Knowledge of test management and defect management tools such as Azure DevOps, JIRA, or equivalent.
* Experience with test automation approaches for data and ETL testing.


Please be aware that this role can only be worked within the UK and not Overseas.
  
  

Disability Confident
  
  

As a member of the Disability Confident Scheme, DWP guarantees to interview all candidates who have a disability and who meet all the essential criteria for the vacancy. In cases where we have a high volume of candidates who have a disability who meet all the essential criteria, we will interview the best candidates from within that group. This scheme encourages candidates with a disability and/or neurodivergence to apply. In exceptional circumstances, we may also need to apply the desirable criteria in our shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.
  
  

Armed Forces Covenant
  
  

DWP guarantees to interview veterans or spouses / partners of military personnel who meet all the essential criteria for the vacancy. In cases where we have a high volume of ex\-military candidates / military spouses or partners, who meet all of the essential criteria, we will interview the best candidates from within that group. In exceptional circumstances, we may also need to apply the desirable criteria in our shortlisting process which may include holding active security clearance.
  
  

In applying for this role, you acknowledge the following "this role falls in scope of the Off Payroll Working in the Public Sector legislation. Any rates of payment quoted will reflect the gross rate per day for the assignment and will be subject to appropriate taxes and statutory costs. As such the payment to the intermediary and your income resulting from this contract will be different".

jobs.title: Cloud DevOps Engineer
jobs.description:
### **Description**

  

**Location:** Sheffield / London / Hybrid Working
 (Expectation that you will attend an office 2 days per week)
**Contract:** Permanent
**Hours:** Full time 37\.5 hours per week/flexible days and/or hours (Mon\-Fri)
**Salary:** Up to £49,875 (Sheffield) / £60,375 (London) depending on experience

**THE ROLE**

As a Cloud DevOps Engineer at the British Business Bank, you will help shape reliable, secure and cost\-effective technology services that support our organisation and its purpose. This is hands\-on engineering role focussed on modern DevOps practices across the full lifecycle of infrastructure management.

Working within Platform Engineering, you will help manage day to day operation and improve our hybrid technology estate, with a particular focus on Microsoft Azure. You will oversee operations across SaaS, IaaS and PaaS services, maintaining Azure networking, compute, storage and platform capabilities. You will also support our on\-premises Windows and Linux Server estate, virtualisation platforms and maintaining wider hybrid operating model.

You will create practical, scalable solutions using Infrastructure as Code, Terraform and automation scripting, while maintaining CI/CD pipelines through Azure DevOps and GitHub Actions.

Your work will include designing and testing backup and disaster recovery arrangements, maintaining monitoring and observability tools, and responding thoughtfully to incidents. You will collaborate with engineering, security and operations colleagues to identify root causes, improve services and embed DevSecOps practices.

You will bring strong Azure engineering experience across infrastructure, platform services, identity and security, alongside extensive knowledge of Terraform, CI/CD, cloud governance, FinOps and the Azure Well\-Architected Framework.  Click here for a complete list of benefits

* 15% employer pension contribution
* Flexible working
* Cycle to work scheme, healthcare cash plan, Group Income Protection and life assurance

jobs.title: Staff InfoSec Engineer
jobs.description:
Krakow, Poland Category Engineering, Product, \& UX Design
  
Job description
At Qualtrics, we create software the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high\-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform—we are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18K clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and a disdain for convention—but most of all it requires close\-knit, high\-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.
  

  

When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set aggressive goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged and complex problems are solved together, by passing the microphone and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities—ready or not, they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.
**Staff InfoSec Engineer**
**Why We Have This Role**


Qualtrics is looking for a Senior Lead of CDU Operations to lead the (Kraków) team’s daily operations that are responsible for detecting, triaging, and responding to security threats across our global environment. You'll own the day\-to\-day operations of your team, build and mentor a high\-performing team of analysts, and continuously mature our detection and response capabilities to keep pace with an evolving threat landscape. This is a hands\-on leadership role — you'll support in guiding strategy while staying close enough to work alongside the team and manage incidents.
**How You’ll Find Success**


* Strategic Visionary: You possess an in\-depth understanding of the cybersecurity threat landscape and proactively identify emerging risks. You help shape the Security Operations strategy, ensuring alignment with the organization's overall goals.
* Technical Innovator: You drive continuous improvement by evaluating and implementing cutting\-edge security tools, techniques, and automation. Your relentless pursuit of innovation keeps us ahead of evolving threats.
* Collaborative Leader: You build strong cross\-functional partnerships, championing security across the organization. You foster a collaborative environment where teams work seamlessly to achieve a strong security posture.
* Resilient and Adaptive: You thrive in a dynamic environment, effectively managing complex security projects and leading teams through change. Your ability to adapt and problem\-solve makes you a key asset during challenging situations.

**How You’ll Grow**


* Shape Industry Standards: Participate in leading security conferences, thought leadership initiatives, and industry working groups to shape the future of cybersecurity practices.
* Executive Presence: Gain direct exposure to executive\-level decision\-making, refining your strategic communication and influencing skills.
* Expand Your Leadership Toolkit: Lead a team of skilled security professionals, providing you with ample opportunities to enhance your mentorship, coaching, and talent development abilities.
* Complex Problem\-Solving: Tackle high\-impact security challenges that will push your critical thinking, analysis, and strategy\-building skills.

**Things You’ll Do**


* Lead and manage the Security Operations Center, including 24x7 monitoring, detection, triage, and incident response functions
* Hire, coach, and develop a team of CDU analysts and incident responders; build career paths and a strong on\-call/rotation culture
* Senior Lead needs hands\-on credibility. Conduct 1\-on\-1 technical coaching, run mock incident drills, and build skill matrices for junior analysts.
* Own CDU metrics and KPIs (MTTD, MTTR, alert volume/fidelity, coverage) and report on program health to security leadership
* Drive continuous improvement of detection logic, playbooks, and automation in partnership with detection engineering and threat intelligence teams
* Serve as an escalation point and incident commander for high\-severity security incidents, coordinating cross\-functional response
* Partner with Threat Intelligence, Detection Engineering, IT, Legal, and Product/Engineering teams to close gaps in visibility and response
* Manage relationships with any outsourced/MSSP or co\-managed CDU partners, ensuring SLAs and quality standards are met
* Evaluate and help select CDU tooling (SIEM, SOAR, EDR, XDR, ticketing) and drive adoption of automation to reduce analyst toil
* Own CDU\-related audit, compliance, and customer trust requirements (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP as applicable)
* Build and maintain incident response runbooks, tabletop exercises, and post\-incident review processes
* Participate in an on\-call rotation for incidents and provide leadership presence during major security events

**What We’re Looking For On Your Resume**


* Required:
	+ 7\+ years in security operations, incident response, or a related security discipline, including 4\+ years in a people\-management or team\-lead role
	+ Demonstrated experience running or scaling a 24x7 CDU function, whether in\-house, hybrid, or via MSSP oversight
	+ Strong technical grounding in SIEM/SOAR platforms, EDR/XDR, network and cloud security monitoring, and the MITRE ATT\&CK framework
	+ Experience leading incident response for significant security events, including coordination with legal, communications, and executive stakeholders
	+ Track record of hiring, developing, and retaining security talent
	+ Excellent communication skills — able to translate technical detail into risk\-based language for non\-technical leaders
	+ Experience with cloud environments (AWS, Azure, or GCP) and SaaS security operations
* Nice to Have:
	+ Experience in a SaaS or enterprise software company handling customer data at scale
	+ Familiarity with compliance frameworks relevant to Qualtrics' customer base (SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP, GDPR)
	+ Relevant certifications (CISSP, GCIH, GCFA, CISM, or similar)
	+ Experience building or maturing threat detection and threat hunting programs
	+ Background in scripting/automation (Python, PowerShell) to support SOAR workflows

**What You Should Know About This Team**


* Innovation at Our Core: Our Security Operations team embraces change and thrives on solving complex challenges. We value experimentation, continuous learning, and push the boundaries of conventional security practices.
* Collaborative Environment: We believe in the power of teamwork and foster open communication across the team and the wider organization. Your ideas will be heard, and your collaboration will be essential.
* Data\-Driven Approach: We rely on data\-driven insights to inform our security strategies, measure effectiveness, and continuously improve our posture.
* Growth Mindset: We are committed to your professional development. You'll have opportunities to expand your expertise, contribute to high\-visibility projects, and advance your career in cybersecurity.
* Joining our team means stepping into a role that's vital, challenging, and deeply linked to Qualtrics' aim of reshaping industries by harnessing the power of Experience Management and AI.
**Our Team’s Favorite Perks and Benefits**


* Annual Leave: 20 or 26 annual leave days per annum plus an additional day for each year of service (to a max of 5\).
* Private Medical Insurance\- Luxmed health \& dental cover for you and your dependants.
* Commuter Assistance\- Up to the value of 80 PLN net a month for public transport.
* Savings Plan\- Two company saving plans provided by Nationale Nederlanden: Employee Capital Plan (PPK) \& Employee Saving Plan (PPO),
* QED PROGRAM\- Qualtrics Engineer Development (QED) program: support, engineering learning activities up to 10% of engineering work time each quarter.
* Wellness\- Up to the value of 800PLN gross per quarter can be reimbursed for a variety of wellness activities via our dedicated platform Forma,
* A choice of Multispot cards available.
* Our employee assistance program with Unum provides counselling and wellbeing support to all employees
* Experience bonus\- 7000 PLN gross per annum. Qualtrics experience bonus is a program designed to provide experiences to our employees they might not otherwise have.
* Group Life \& Income Protection Insurance

* Free breakfasts, lunches, snacks, and drinks for everyone in the office
* Tax\-deductible expenses (up to 50% depending on role)

**The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model**: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organizational leader. These purposeful in\-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. jobs.title: Senior Cloud Developer (Azure/MS Data Fabric/Collibra)
jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.
  

  

Your Skills And Experiences
  

  

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python
* Experience working with customers face to face, leading and driving discussions with senior personnel regarding trade\-offs, best practices, project management, and risk mitigation
* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)
* Solid understanding of DevOps principles and experience with configuring and running CI/CD platforms such as Azure DevOps
* Good understanding of networking concepts (TCP/IP, routing, etc.)
* Proactive thinking, excellent problem\-solving, and analytical skills
* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

##### **Responsibilities**


Support the integration between Collibra and Microsoft Fabric, including evaluating Fabric's capabilities for data provision.


Manage Fabric\-native catalog and discovery functionalities.


Oversee metadata management and business glossary maintenance.


Facilitate data product discovery and data shopping processes.


Handle governance, access management, and data protection policies.


Lead proof\-of\-concept initiatives and validate Fabric architecture.


Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.


Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.


Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.


Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.


Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.


Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.


Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.


##### **Skills**


Must have


Python,


Infrastructure as a Service (IaaS),


Microsoft Azure DevOps,


Microsoft Azure Services,


Microsoft Data Fabric,


Network,


IP Routing,


TCP/IP,


CI/CD


Nice to have


Proven experience of working with MS Data Fabric (DP\-600/DP\-700 certifications),


experience in building AI Landing zones,


experience with FabricIO \& o365 agents,


C\# proficiency, Databricks,


self\-driven/self\-motivated,


PowerShell.

* Great opportunity to gain hands\-on, practical experience at the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI within the IT industry

jobs.title: Cloud Developer – Building high-performance DevEx tools in Go/Golang
jobs.description:
The world of cloud is changing. Fast. And we want you, who thrive on the bleeding edge and build cleanly in **Go**, to transform the Cloud space with us!


We’re growing our team with a low\-ego, collaborative, and backend\-focused Cloud Developer who sees **Golang** as their home turf and **Developer Experience (DevEx)** as their main product. You are the force multiplier for client engineering teams: the connective tissue that builds internal tooling, CLI tools, microservices, and paved roads that allow everyone else to ship faster, safer, and with true engineering discipline, especially in an AI\-accelerated dev world.


If you love the simplicity, concurrency, and raw speed of Go, and get a kick out of building tools that other developers actually enjoy using, this is your Playground.


At heart, this is a developer\-productivity role. On assignment, you are the one who elevates a client's entire engineering engine:

* **Go as the core language:** You'll build internal services, custom CLIs, operator tooling, and lightweight backends primarily written in Go. *Of course*, we realize that you probably enjoy other languages as well (could be Java, Python, Typescript, .NET etc.) and this role is not at all limited to Go, it just has to be a proven weapon of choise in your arsenal
* **The Cloud is your substrate:** You bridge code, infrastructure, and delivery pipelines (CI/CD, IaC) so that shipping code to AWS, Azure, or GCP feels effortless for the rest of the team
* **DevEx in the AI Era:** Client teams are shipping faster than ever with AI coding tools. Your job is to build the surrounding guardrails, testing harnesses, and Go\-based tooling that keep that speed safe, reliable, and clean


You’re less about churning out standard end\-user business logic, and more about eliminating friction, reducing toil, and building the high\-speed infrastructure that other devs rely on daily.

### **What this role is (and is not)**

**What this role is:**

* **Primary Go/Golang Development:** Designing and building fast, concurrent, and reliable internal services, CLI tools, libraries, and developer platforms
* **Smoothing the path to production:** Developing CI/CD, build pipelines, and paved roads that make shipping code fast, safe, and repeatable
* **Elevating team velocity:** Doing the architectural and connective work that acts as a force multiplier for whole engineering orgs
* **Bringing discipline to AI workflow:** Creating the harnesses, guardrails, and integrations that let teams leverage AI without introducing chaos

**What this role is not:**

* **Not a "vanilla" feature dev:** You won't be stuck in standard CRUD/backlog feature loops. Your product is the developer platform itself
* **Not a frontend or pure Data/ML role:** You consume and integrate AI services and cloud primitives
* You don't train ML models or build data pipelines as your core craft

### **Who are you?**


Your temperament matters as much as your code. You’re a curious, low\-ego builder who takes pride in system craftsmanship, writes clean and maintainable Go code, and communicates clearly.

**Skills \& Background:**

* **Go (Golang) is your primary language and home turf:** You know its concurrency patterns, standard library, and ecosystem inside out.
* **5\+ years** in software engineering / backend / cloud engineering, with a genuine passion for *building for builders*
* Comfort or depth in at least one secondary modern language (e.g., Python, C\#, Java, or TypeScript)
* **Cloud \& IaC experience:** Solid foundation in AWS, Azure, or GCP, combined with Infrastructure as Code (Pulumi or Terraform preferred)
* **Demonstrable engagement with AI tooling:** Whether it’s building CLI wrappers around LLMs, using AI coding assistants in your workflow, or integrating AI SDKs into Go apps
* **Fluency in Swedish and English** (as client engagements are primarily conducted in Swedish)


Bonus: Kubernetes experience (managed or self\-managed).


Note: no ss\-hats wanted or needed.

### **Let's Play!**


Applying to us is a breeze!

* Upload your resumé or use your Linkedin profile
* Answer the choice\-questions (no "please\-rewrite\-your\-resume" nonsense, promise)
* Feel free to include links to your portfolio, GitHub or similar if you have stuff you're proud of that you want to share with us

**Important notes:**

* Playground Group does *not*provide visa sponsorship or relocation support
* Applicants must already have a permanent *and* independent right to work in Sweden
* As part of the final stage of the recruitment process, a background check conducted by a third party will be carried out.

### **Welcome to Playground!**


At Playground, you work on real, complex assignments for well\-established and ambitious clients, not bench projects or short\-lived experiments. Our teams are trusted with production systems, platforms, and data that actually matter. Here growth comes from ownership, curiosity, and doing the work properly. You’re trusted to think, contribute, and keep getting better, one meaningful step at a time.


Playground brings together specialized domains under one umbrella, with a shared culture and way of working, and easy access to broad technical expertise when it helps move the work forward.


Buzz: Cloud Engineer, SW Developer, Fullstack Developer, Software Architect, Coder, Hacker, Utvecklare, AI, AWS, GCP, Azure, Cloud Consultant

jobs.title: Senior Energy Engineer
jobs.description:
Arden Energy is an electricity supply and professional energy management services company established in 2007\.

The company’s founding ethos is the belief that organisations proactively addressing energy efficiency will gain a competitive advantage as energy costs rise and environmental challenges become greater. Our key selling points are transparency, empowerment and competitive electricity tariffs. .

Arden Energy provides services to Government Agencies and industrial clients. We are at are at the forefront of the development and deployment of ICT technologies for energy management and grid flexibility and we engage in research into sustainable energy technologies and techniques.

**Job Description**

As a senior energy engineer you will:

* Lead research projects related to energy management and ICT (e.g. smart metering, BMS)
* Deliver energy management services to clients, facilitating and driving energy use and cost reductions.
* Collate, analyse and report on complex sets of energy data using excel and other software tools.
* Visit clients and prospective clients to carry out energy audits for commercial and industrial markets and provide a business case for investment in energy efficiency.
* Initiate and develop strong business relationships with clients.
* Assist in the development and maintenance of our energy management platform; Analysing and reporting on energy related data.
* Implement AI and machine learning to streamline business and data management processes.
* Manage integration of external data sources into the Arden platform using APIs and other appropriate tools.

This role offers an ambitious professional the opportunity to deploy advanced energy solutions with a market leader, directly accelerating Ireland’s transition to a smart, net\-zero power grid.

**Qualification and Skills**

**Essential Criteria:**

* Hons Degree in Engineering or related discipline.
* Background in an energy engineering/consultancy role preferably with experience of energy auditing and energy management.
* Comprehensive knowledge and understanding of energy efficiency, energy management and renewable energy sources.
* Excellent project management/organisational skills with ability to concurrently manage diverse workloads and competing demands.
* Strong ICT, data management and data analysis skills with hands on technical experience
* Strong report writing skills .
* Candidates must be currently eligible to work in Ireland without restriction and must hold valid work permit/visa if required.

**Desirable Criteria:**

* Specialist professional qualification desirable (eg Masters, Chartered, SEAI Registered Energy Auditor etc.)
* Experience of energy research.
* Ability to work autonomously and proactively contribute to business development.

Job Types: Full\-time, Permanent

Pay: €60,000\.00\-€80,000\.00 per year

Benefits:

* Profit sharing

Education:

* Bachelor's (required)

Language:

* Fluent English (required)

Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Graduate Structural Engineer
jobs.description:
Join Our Team:
**PLEASE NOTE THIS POSITION IS TO START IN SEPTEMBER 2027**  

With 29 locations, Cundall’s global presence allows our structural engineers to be involved in many challenging and exciting building projects.

  

Working across a variety of industry sectors, our Structures teams are renowned for producing innovative and award\-winning sustainable engineering solutions throughout the lifecycle of any building project. To build on our great work so far, we are looking for graduates who want to create, improve and protect the environment in which we live and provide the facilities for day\-to\-day life, transport and industry to function effectively.  

The Structural engineering teams provide industry\-leading expertise – and offer a pro\-active and collaborative approach to skill development, and professional excellence. Join us and you could be a part of a team who built a state\-of\-the\-art faculty of medical sciences for a university campus, Eton College Sports and Aquatic Centre, The All England Lawn Tennis Club (AELTC’s) Somerset Road project or King's College School, Wimbledon \- new music school.
The Role You'll Play:

In this graduate role, you’ll join our Structural Engineering team to work on the design of some of the most exciting construction design projects in Ireland and worldwide. Working closely with colleagues across our multi\-disciplinary practice, you’ll provide specialist consultancy input on projects across a wide range of sectors.  

Join us as a Graduate Structural Engineer and you’ll work with and be guided by a team of expert engineers to carry out conceptual as well as detailed structural engineering design and analysis, using your maths, science, and problem\-solving skills to design inspirational and sustainable structures and more.  

This role will require you to use your knowledge and expertise to define and translate clients’ needs into designs for buildings, infrastructure, facilities, and services with sustainability at the forefront of the design.  

You’ll have the opportunity over time to assume greater levels of responsibility and autonomy as your professional skills develop, and with accredited professional development programmes from the IStructE or ICE, you’ll be supported towards Chartership.
The Skills You'll Bring:
* On target to achieve at least a 2:2 degree.
* Desirable if accredited with or on course to achieve a BEng/MEng degree level (or equivalent) in Structural Engineering or Civil Engineering.
* You’ll have a keen interest in structural design and analysis for the built environment, and crucially \- have a passion for creative and intuitive design.
* Possessing a desire for personal and professional development, you’ll have the proven ability to work effectively as part of a team.
* Digital engineering is a big focus at Cundall, so ideally, you’ll have an understanding of Parametric Modelling Techniques (Grasshopper or Dynamo), or at least one modern programming language (e.g. Python, C\#, VB).
* You are organised and methodical in your approach to managing your tasks and priorities, striving to meet deadlines.
* Collaborative in nature, you’ll be able to empathise with your clients’ needs and utilise excellent communication skills, both in writing and verbally, with internal and external stakeholders. You’re used to using your initiative to overcome challenges and have a positive, can\-do attitude.

**What’s in it for you?**

  

We offer a competitive starting salary which grows as you develop, as well as many training and development opportunities to make sure you keep progressing.

  

Aside from this, those who successfully join our graduate scheme also enjoy:

* A one\-off joining bonus of €1,500, payable during your first week of employment.
* A €2,000 bonus on gaining chartered status with a relevant professional body.
* 25 days' holiday per annum (plus statutory holidays).
* A flexible benefits package which enables you to select additional benefits to suit your personal circumstances.

Creating environments where everyone can find joy doing their best work is also great for everyone. That’s why we positively welcome applications from people of all backgrounds and identities, and encourage, support, and celebrate the diverse voices of our people.**

jobs.title: AI Operations Engineer
jobs.description:
AI is already changing how work gets done at CatalystOne. We're looking for someone who can design, build and operate AI solutions that create real business value, removing manual work, improving processes and helping colleagues focus on higher\-value work.


The whole company is your remit, the work is already underway, and we're small enough that something you build can be used by colleagues within weeks. This is an opportunity to help shape an AI practice from the beginning and see your work create visible impact across the business.


At CatalystOne, we help organisations create better workplaces through HR technology. Across the Nordics, we combine technology, people expertise and business understanding to help customers improve how work gets done. We're now applying the same thinking internally as we continue to expand how AI supports our own organisation.

### **About the AI Hub**


The AI Hub is a new function within People \& Technology, created to help CatalystOne identify, prioritise and realise the value of AI across the business.


We don't see AI as purely a technology topic. Introducing AI changes how work is organised, what people need to learn, and where human judgement matters most. We want those conversations considered together, close to the people doing the work.


The purpose of the AI Hub is to bring together process improvement, organisational change and technology to help teams work better and deliver stronger outcomes. As our AI Operations Engineer, you'll play a key role in turning ideas into solutions that people use every day.

### **The role**


Your users are your colleagues.


You'll build the systems, automations and AI\-powered solutions that consultants, support teams, sales teams and back\-office functions rely on to do their work. You'll work directly with the people experiencing the problem, helping shape solutions that fit how work actually happens.


This is a small team with a short path from idea to implementation. Some opportunities can move from a conversation on Monday to a solution in production that same week. Others require deeper technical design, data modelling or integration work. You'll help make those calls and take ownership of what gets built long after launch.


You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager to assess opportunities and agree scope. The AI Business Partner leads process improvement, adoption and value measurement. You lead technical design, engineering and operations. Both of you are involved while the problem is being defined and stay close after launch to ensure solutions create lasting value.


Some examples of what is already live


This isn't a greenfield AI initiative. We already have solutions creating value across CatalystOne today, including:

* An AI support agent that resolves around a fifth of internal IT tickets before they reach the IT team.
* Data products that save consultants time and provide business insights we didn't previously have.
* Automated workflows that reduce manual administration and move information seamlessly between teams.

The AI Hub exists to build on that foundation, helping CatalystOne identify the next opportunities, improve how work gets done, and ensure new solutions deliver measurable business value.

### **What you'll do**


You'll typically be involved throughout the entire lifecycle of a solution, from the first conversation through to operation and continuous improvement.


Your work will include:

* Building AI agents, automations and integrations that remove manual work and improve how teams operate.
* Working directly with colleagues to understand problems and shape practical solutions.
* Designing data models, workflows and integrations that support reliable AI solutions.
* Deciding where automation makes sense, where AI adds value and where human judgement should remain part of the process.
* Owning the solutions you build, including reliability, monitoring, security and cost management.
* Improving solutions based on how people actually use them.
* Creating documentation and reusable patterns that allow others to understand, maintain and extend your work.
### **Our technology stack**


Today we use Claude Code and Anthropic models, our own MCP servers running on Azure Container Apps, Copilot Studio, Azure AI Foundry, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions and Logic Apps. We already have agentic workflows running in production.


The tools will change. If something better comes along and you can make the case for it, you'll have room to improve the setup. Whatever we run needs to be secure, understandable, maintainable and cost\-effective.

### **What we're looking for**


We're less interested in a specific career path than in your ability to build reliable solutions that people depend on.


You'll likely bring:

* Experience building integrations, backend services, automations or internal platforms.
* Strong technical foundations in areas such as Azure, Microsoft Graph, APIs, serverless technologies, Python or C\#.
* Experience delivering AI\-powered solutions that real users rely on.
* Good technical judgement and the ability to choose simple solutions when they solve the problem.
* An understanding of security, reliability and operational ownership.
* Awareness of the trade\-offs between capability, speed, complexity and cost.
* The ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non\-technical colleagues.

You care about the work behind the request, not just the technology. You want to understand how people use what you've built, whether they trust it and how it can be improved over time.


You don't need HR or HCM experience. If this sounds broadly like you, we'd love to hear from you.

### **What success looks like**


Your first few weeks will be about understanding our infrastructure, the solutions already running and the colleagues who use them.


You'll work closely with the AI Business Partner and the IT Manager on new opportunities, helping assess what is technically possible and where the best place to start might be.


We want you building early, while giving you enough time to understand the environment you're responsible for.


By day 90, we'd expect you to have taken ownership of parts of the existing platform, contributed to new solutions entering production, and built strong relationships with the colleagues using them.

### **Why join CatalystOne?**


This is an opportunity to help build an AI practice from the beginning and see your work used by colleagues across the company.


You'll have the chance to:

* Build solutions that create visible business impact.
* Work directly with the people using what you build.
* Shape how the AI Hub develops.
* Experiment with modern AI technologies while staying focused on real business outcomes.
* Take ownership from idea through production and continuous improvement.

If you're excited by the opportunity to build practical AI solutions, solve meaningful business problems and help shape the future of work at CatalystOne, we'd love to hear from you.

### **Benefits**


As well as your salary, you’ll receive:

* Generous time off: A solid vacation allowance so you can recharge and regroup.
* Financial and health security: A comprehensive pension and insurance package, including private healthcare.
* Your well being, your way: A wellness contribution to help you stay on top of your health.
* Tech tools for efficiency: Laptop, mobile phone with subscription, and a home internet allowance.
* Flexible work setup: A hybrid model that supports your work life balance, with at least three days a week in the office.
* And more: Local benefits vary slightly by office, and we are happy to walk you through the details.
*CatalystOne does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. CatalystOne will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to the specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to CatalystOne on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.*

*We would like to inform you that all candidates who receive a job offer will be subject to a background check.*

jobs.title: Senior Technical Architect
jobs.description:
Hyvä arkkitehtuuri on kuin hyvä perustus: sitä ei huomaa, ennen kuin se puuttuu. Nyt etsimme kokenutta Technical Architectia, joka voi varmistaa softakehityksen vankan perustan.

Jos tunnistat itsesi tästä, saatat olla etsimämme asiantuntija:

Olet kokenut Technical Architect, jolla on vähintään kahdeksan vuoden kokemus softa\-arkkitehtuurista. Toimit asiakasprojekteissa itsenäisesti ja luotat omaan asiantuntijuuteesi. Suunnittelet järjestelmiä, jotka kestävät kuormaa, muutoksia ja aikaa. Huomioit valinnoissasi skaalautuvuuden, suorituskyvyn, tietoturvan ja ylläpidettävyyden, ja osaat perustella ne kehitystiimille yhtä selkeästi kuin asiakkaalle.

Taustasi on ohjelmistokehityksessä, joten tiedät, miltä arkkitehtuuri näyttää koodin tasolla. Osaat analysoida olemassa olevia ratkaisuja, tunnistaa teknisen velan ja viedä järjestelmiä hallitusti kohti modernimpaa arkkitehtuuria. Osaat myös jakaa osaamistasi ja parhaita käytäntöjä ymmärrettävällä ja käytännönläheisellä tavalla.

Saatat etsiä seuraavaa työpaikkaasi tai seuraavaa projektiasi yrittäjänä.

**Millaista osaamista etsimme**

* Vähintään 8 vuoden kokemusta ohjelmistokehityksestä ja järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista
* Kokemusta teknisen arkkitehtuurin suunnittelusta ja dokumentoinnista
* Vahvaa osaamista pilviarkkitehtuureista ja \-palveluista
* Kokemusta mikropalvelu\-, tapahtumapohjaisista ja/tai hajautetuista arkkitehtuureista
* Hyvää ymmärrystä integraatioista, rajapinnoista ja data\-arkkitehtuurista
* Ymmärrystä tietoturvasta, identiteetinhallinnasta ja ei\-toiminnallisista vaatimuksista
* Kokemusta DevOps\-käytännöistä, CI/CD\-putkista ja infrastruktuurista koodina
* Kykyä toimia itsenäisesti asiakasprojekteissa ja ohjata kehitystiimejä teknisissä ratkaisuissa
* Eduksi katsomme kokemuksen legacy\-järjestelmien modernisointi\- ja migraatioprojekteista, tuntemuksen julkisen sektorin tietoturvavaatimuksista (esim. Julkri) sekä arkkitehtuuriin liittyvät sertifikaatit (esim. Azure Solutions Architect Expert tai AWS Certified Solutions Architect)

Arvostamme kokemusta esimerkiksi seuraavista teknologioista: Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Kubernetes, Docker, OpenShift, Terraform, Kafka, REST, GraphQL, API Management, Java, .NET, Node.js, PostgreSQL, CI/CD, C4\-malli, ArchiMate

Emme oleta, että osaat kaikkia listattuja teknologioita. Jos sinulla on vahva kokemus järjestelmäarkkitehtuurista ja teknisten ratkaisujen suunnittelusta, kuulemme sinusta mielellämme! Kerrothan meille hakemuksessasi tarkemmin juuri sinun vahvuuksistasi.

**Mahdollisia työtehtäviäsi**

* Järjestelmien ja ohjelmistojen teknisen arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
* Pilvi\- ja hybridiympäristöjen arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen ja kehittäminen
* Teknologiavalintojen tekeminen ja perusteleminen
* Integraatio\- ja data\-arkkitehtuurin suunnitteleminen
* Skaalautuvuuden, suorituskyvyn, tietoturvan ja toimintavarmuuden varmistaminen
* Olemassa olevien järjestelmien arvioiminen ja modernisoinnin suunnitteleminen
* Arkkitehtuurikatselmointien tekeminen ja kehitystiimien tekninen ohjaaminen
* Yhteistyö asiakkaiden, kehittäjien, ratkaisuarkkitehtien ja muiden sidosryhmien kanssa
* Oman osaamisen jakaminen ja muiden asiantuntijoiden sparraaminen

**Prosessi ja palkkaus**

Käymme kaikki hakemukset läpi ja vastaamme jokaiselle. Tutustumme sinuun CV:n tai LinkedIn\-profiilisi kautta ja käymme myös nykyiset projektimme läpi. Mikäli projekteistamme saattaisi nyt tai lähitulevaisuudessa löytyä sinulle sopiva toimeksianto, kutsumme sinut tutustumistapaamiseen. Kun sinulle mahdollisesti sopiva asiakasprojekti löytyy, ja asiakas kiinnostuu osaamisestasi, haluaa hän useimmiten haastatella sinut kerran tai pari ennen lopullisen päätöksensä tekemistä. Mikäli asiakas haluaa sinut konsultikseen, pääsemme tekemään tarvittavat sopimukset: joko työsopimuksen tai alihankintasopimuksen, mikäli toimit mieluummin yrittäjänä.

Palkka määräytyy kokemuksen ja projektin perusteella välille 5000\-8000\+ €/kk. Halutessasi voit valita kiinteän tai laskutettuihin tunteihin perustuvan palkkamallin. Jos toimit alihankkijana, on tuntilaskutus useimmiten 60\-100\+ €/h.

**Lisätietoa meistä**

Marvel Consulting on noin 30 hengen asiantuntijatiimi, ja me kasvamme jatkuvasti! Etsimme IT\-alan osaajille mielenkiintoisia konsultointiprojekteja erilaisten asiakkaidemme parista. Työskentelemme pääosin vaativissa IT\-projekteissa tukemalla asiakkaitamme heidän hankkeissaan, joihin liittyvät toimeksiannot kestävät usein kuukausia tai jopa vuosia. Asiakkaamme vaihtelevat pienyrityksistä startupeihin ja suuryrityksiin sekä julkisiin toimijoihin.

Tarjoamme asiantuntijoillemme:

* Kilpailukykyisen palkan
* Erittäin osaavat (ja mukavat!) kollegat
* Mielenkiintoisia ja merkityksellisiä projekteja
* Hyvät työsuhde\-edut sekä laajan työterveyden
* Toiveiden mukaiset ja projektin tarpeisiin vastaavat työvälineet

**Huomioithan: Tällä hetkellä suurin osa projekteistamme edellyttää, että asiantuntija asuu Suomessa ja puhuu suomea. Projektista riippuen asiakas saattaa tarvita läsnäoloa toimistollaan, mutta usein projekteissa on mahdollisuus myös hybridi\- tai etätyölle.**

Työn tyyppi: Kokopäivätyö

Palkka: 5 000,00€ \- 8 000,00€ per kuukausi

Työpaikan sijainti: Henkilökohtainen

jobs.title: Product Engineer - Construction
jobs.description:
**Help shape how AI and human engineering come together to build market\-leading software for the construction industry.**

*Are you a hands\-on developer who understands both the technical and customer sides of great software? Do you want to work at the frontier of AI\-assisted development, guiding both engineers and AI agents to deliver real value for our customers?*

*Then you might be our new Product Engineer!*

You will join EG's Construction R\&D organisation, working on Jydacom, ERP platform used across the construction industry. You will report to Timo Valonen, Senior Manager, Construction R\&D management, and work closely with developers, AI agents, Product Owners, and Product Managers on a daily basis.


Most of the development team is in Mangaluru, India, while your Finnish colleagues and stakeholders are based in Jyväskylä. English is the primary working language across the team, but fluent Finnish spoken and written is required to work closely with local stakeholders. The role is based in our Jyväskylä office.

**The Role**

**What you'll be doing**

* Gather and translate customer requirements into technical solutions.
* Deliver the final software product full\-stack — from frontend to backend and beyond to production deployment and monitoring.
* Ensure the whole path of quality from unit testing to production monitoring.
* Implement features and initiatives according to the product roadmap.
* Take ownership of internal tooling development.
* Also contribute to DevOps practices alongside the engineering team, helping maintain strong operational capability.
* Work closely with an Indian development team, leveraging AI in the development process.
* Collaborate primarily with internal stakeholders across the organization.
* Turning complex business logic into simple, elegant technical solutions.

**What You Bring**  

We care more about what you can do than what your CV looks like. Here's what will set you up for success:

**Must\-have**

* Senior\-level background as a software developer, with \+5 years of experience.
* Experience with modern web development, REST API.
* A production delivery mindset — you build production\-ready solutions designed to last.
* Understanding of how to build sustainable software products that meet customer needs in time while maintaining high technical quality.
* Experience delivering solutions fulfilling non\-functional technical requirements like maintainability, performance, security, observability.
* Strong collaboration skills and willingness to work in an international environment.
* Fluent written and spoken English and Finnish.

**Nice\-to\-have**

* Demonstrated experience designing or maintaining systems with extensive third\-party integrations and complex data models.
* Hands\-on development experience with Angular, TypeScript, .NET, and C\#.
* Experience with Microsoft SQL Server, Azure, Power BI, and Fabric.
* Familiarity with Windows server, IIS, Kubernetes and GitHub Actions.

**What's in it for you?**

* **Real ownership** — Own the quality and consistency of what AI agents and developers deliver, with real influence over how our software is built.

**Our Values**

* **Stronger Together —** We collaborate across borders with high standards, trust, openness and no politics.  

  

**We look forward to hearing from you!**  

If you would like more information before you apply, please contact our Senior Manager, Construction R\&D management, Timo Valonen, at timva@eg.fi or \+358 40 5593685\. We evaluate applications on an ongoing basis and recruit when the right candidate is found, so please send your CV and application as soon as possible. All inquiries are handled confidentially.

Our industry\-specific software helps people and businesses work smarter every day. From doctors spending more time with patients to builders running safer, more efficient projects.
