jobs.title: Automation Software Engineer, Central Maintenance
jobs.description:
**OUR STORY**

  

**At STMicroelectronics, we believe in the power of technology to drive innovation and make a positive impact on people, businesses, and society. As a global semiconductor company, our advanced technologies and chips form the hidden foundation of the world we live in today.**

  

**When you join ST, you will be part of a global business with more than 122 nationalities, present in 40 countries, and comprising over 49,000 diverse and dedicated creators and makers of technology around the world.**

  

**Developing technologies takes more than talent: it takes amazing people who understand collaboration and respect. People with passion and the desire to disrupt the status quo, drive innovation, and unlock their own potential.**

**Embark on a journey with us, where you can innovate for a future that we want to make smarter and greener, in a responsible and sustainable way. Our technology starts with you.**

**Your role**

As an **Automation Software Engineer** , you will develop and **support software solutions** that enable automation, data acquisition, process control, and equipment integration in a high\-volume **semiconductor manufacturing** environment. You will work closely with equipment engineering, process engineering, production, quality, and DTIT teams to improve tool uptime (e.g. ALTS, SAM Machines, DAP/DAS, CPS etc), process stability, traceability, yield, and overall tool performance.


**Your responsibilities will include:**

* Develop, maintain, and optimize automation and equipment control software for (DAP/DAS, ALTS, SAM Machines etc) semiconductor manufacturing systems.
* Support integration of production tools, test equipment, sensors, databases, MES, and factory host systems.
* Monitor, debug, and troubleshoot automation software, interfaces, and manufacturing applications to ensure stable operation.
* Analyze process and equipment data to identify abnormalities, improve performance, and support root\-cause analysis.
* Contribute to equipment qualification (User Acceptance Testing), software validation, and deployment of new automation solutions or upgrades.
* Document software logic, interface specifications, change records, and operating procedures.
* Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on yield, cycle time, quality, reliability, cost, and safety.

**Your skills and experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science/Engineering, Software Engineering, Electronics, Automation, Mechatronics, or a related technical field.
* 1–3 years of experience in software development, automation, industrial control systems, or semiconductor manufacturing support.
* Strong programming skills in one or more languages such as **Python, C\#, C\+\+** , **Java** , or similar.
* Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing systems such as **PLCs, MES, SECS/GEM** , databases, and equipment interfaces is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot technical issues and perform root\-cause analysis **CAPA** .
* Good communication and teamwork skills, with the ability to collaborate across engineering and production functions.
* Ability to work in a structured, fast\-paced cleanroom environment.
* Proactive, detail\-oriented, and eager to grow technically in a semiconductor manufacturing setting.
* Internship, project, or hands\-on experience in semiconductor automation or test software is an advantage.
* Build and maintain customized dashboards and reports to monitor system health, throughput, and utilization
* Extensive knowledge of Microsoft office suite

ST is proud to be one of the 17 companies certified as a 2026 Global Top Employer and the first and only semiconductor company to achieve this distinction. ST was recognized in this ranking thanks to its continuous improvement approach and stands out particularly in the areas of ethics \& integrity, purpose \& values, organization \& change, business strategy, and performance.


At ST, we endeavor to foster a diverse and inclusive workplace, and we do not tolerate discrimination. We aim to recruit and retain a diverse workforce that reflects the societies around us. We strive for equity in career development, career opportunities, and equal remuneration. We encourage candidates who may not meet every single requirement to apply, as we appreciate diverse perspectives and provide opportunities for growth and learning. Diversity, equity, and inclusion (DEI) is woven into our company culture.  



  

To discover more, visit st.com/careers.

jobs.title: Full Stack Engineer (GenAI and Agentic Applications)
jobs.description:
**About Capgemini**

Capgemini is an AI\-powered global business and technology transformation partner, delivering tangible business value. We imagine the future of organizations and make it real with AI, technology and people. With our strong heritage of nearly 60 years, we are a responsible and diverse group of over 420,000 team members in more than 50 countries. We deliver end\-to\-end services and solutions with our deep industry expertise and strong partner ecosystem, leveraging our capabilities across strategy, technology, design, engineering and business operations. The Group reported 2025 global revenues of €22\.5 billion.


**About the Role**
------------------

We are looking for an experienced, product\-minded Software Engineer to work directly with business units and use our established enterprise GenAI platform to deliver high\-impact AI and automation solutions.


In this forward\-deployed role, you will partner closely with business users to understand their workflows, translate often ambiguous needs into well\-scoped solutions, and own delivery from discovery and rapid prototyping through production rollout, adoption, and handover. You will build agentic workflows and custom applications using frameworks such as LangGraph and n8n, supported by strong backend, API, database, evaluation, and security engineering.


**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* **Business Discovery \& Solution Shaping:** Embed with business units to understand operational workflows, pain points, data, constraints, and intended outcomes. Facilitate discovery sessions, challenge assumptions, and translate needs into prioritised use cases, user stories, solution designs, and measurable success criteria.
* **Rapid Prototyping \& Iterative Delivery:** Build working prototypes quickly, validate them with users, and iterate based on evidence. Balance speed with maintainable engineering and take viable solutions through production deployment.
* **Agentic Workflow Engineering:** Design and implement reliable AI workflows and agents using Python\-based frameworks and orchestration tools such as LangGraph, LangChain, n8n, or equivalent technologies. Combine deterministic steps, LLM reasoning, tool calling, state management, human approvals, and exception handling as appropriate.
* **Custom Application Development:** Build fit\-for\-purpose applications around business use cases, including backend services, APIs, integrations, authentication, workflow logic, and lightweight user interfaces where needed.

**Responsibilities**

* **AWS Ecosystem Administration:** Provision, configure, and manage essential AWS services supporting our applications. This includes managed relational databases (RDS PostgreSQL), search/analytics (OpenSearch), AI services (Bedrock), and networking/load balancing (ELB).
* **Network Architecture, Security \& Connectivity:** Design, operate, and troubleshoot secure AWS network architectures for regulated, multi\-account environments. This includes VPC and subnet design, CIDR planning, Transit Gateway routing and route\-table segmentation, centralized ingress and egress, AWS Network Firewall and WAF, security groups and network ACLs, private connectivity through VPC endpoints or AWS PrivateLink, DNS resolution, load balancing, and connectivity to shared services or on\-premises networks through VPN or Direct Connect. Apply network segmentation and least\-privilege principles across production, non\-production, management, and shared\-service environments.
* **Production Reliability, Observability \& Resilience:** Establish service\-level indicators and objectives, dashboards, alerts, logs, metrics, and distributed traces across infrastructure, Kubernetes, applications, and AI workloads. Lead incident response, root\-cause analysis, corrective actions, capacity planning, backup and restore testing, and disaster\-recovery exercises to meet agreed recovery objectives.
* **Infrastructure as Code, CI/CD \& Automation:** Use Terraform as the primary Infrastructure as Code tool to provision and manage repeatable AWS and Kubernetes environments. Administer and optimise GitLab CI/CD pipelines with automated testing, SAST, DAST, dependency and container scanning, policy checks, approval controls, immutable artefacts, environment promotion, rollback mechanisms, and auditable release records.
* **Compliance, Security Engineering \& Vulnerability Management:** Embed security controls throughout the platform lifecycle, including threat modelling, secure architecture reviews, vulnerability and patch management, penetration testing, hardening, remediation tracking, audit evidence, and technical risk assessments. Work with cybersecurity, governance, product, and project stakeholders to translate government security requirements and enterprise standards into automated, testable controls.
* **Identity, Secrets \& Software Supply Chain Security:** Implement least\-privilege IAM, workload identity, privileged\-access controls, secrets and certificate management, container image signing and scanning, software bills of materials, dependency governance, and policy enforcement across infrastructure and deployment pipelines. Protect sensitive configuration and credentials, and maintain traceability of changes and releases.
* **Vendor Transition:** Work closely alongside existing external vendors to map the current architecture, reverse\-engineer undocumented configurations, and safely transition infrastructure operations fully in\-house.
**Requirements**
----------------

* **Experience:** Typically 2 to 5\+ years of hands\-on experience in DevOps, DevSecOps, Cloud Engineering, or a similar role. We welcome candidates with fewer years of experience who can demonstrate strong practical capability, sound engineering fundamentals, and ownership of production systems. Hands\-on production experience with Kubernetes and Terraform is mandatory; depth of capability and evidence of impact will be valued over years of service.
* **Cloud \& Kubernetes:** Strong proficiency in AWS infrastructure, together with substantial hands\-on experience designing, deploying, securing, operating, troubleshooting, and upgrading production Kubernetes clusters and workloads. Strong experience with AWS EKS and Kubernetes networking is required, including ingress controllers, load balancers, service discovery, network policies, pod and service CIDR planning, and diagnosis of cross\-VPC or restricted\-egress connectivity issues.
* **AWS Networking:** Strong knowledge of complex AWS networking in multi\-account and regulated environments. Candidates should be able to design and troubleshoot VPCs, subnets, route tables, Transit Gateway attachments and segmentation, overlapping or constrained CIDR ranges, centralized firewalls and egress, VPC endpoints and PrivateLink, Route 53 private DNS, security groups, network ACLs, VPN or Direct Connect connectivity, and traffic flows across application, shared\-service, security, and on\-premises network zones.

* **Operational Readiness:** Proven experience defining service\-level objectives, building actionable monitoring and alerting, responding to production incidents, conducting root\-cause analysis, managing capacity, and designing and testing backup, restore, and disaster\-recovery arrangements.

**Job Title:** Technical Principal Consultant, AVEVA Unified Engineering

**Location:** Malaysia, Singapore

**Employment Type:** Full\-time, regular, hybrid work arrangement

**The job**

We are seeking a technically skilled engineer to join our team as a Technical Principal Consultant for AVEVA Unified Engineering (UE). This role focuses on the hands\-on implementation, configuration, and integration of UE within complex plant engineering environments. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in engineering data systems, software customization, and cross\-discipline integration.

**Key responsibilities**

* Lead the technical implementation of AVEVA Unified Engineering solutions for EPCs and Owner Operators.
* Configure and customize UE modules to align with customer\-specific engineering workflows.
* Integrate UE with other AVEVA tools (e.g., ERM, AIM\-A, Worktasks etc) and third\-party systems via Application Program Interfaces (APIs).
* Develop scripts and extensions using PML, C\#, .NET, or other relevant technologies.
* Collaborate with customer teams to define data models, templates, and workflows.
* Create and maintain technical documentation including Requirement Definition Documents (RDDs), configuration guides, and training materials.
* Conduct technical workshops and training sessions for end users and administrators.
* Provide advanced troubleshooting and post\-deployment support.
* Consult with global AVEVA development and support teams to resolve complex issues and contribute to product improvements.

**Required Skills and Experience**

* 15\+ years of experience with AVEVA Unified Engineering or similar integrated engineering platforms
* Proficiency in engineering data modeling and multi\-discipline integration (process, piping, electrical, instrumentation)
* Hands\-on experience with AVEVA Engineering, P\&ID, E3D, or comparable tools
* Strong programming/scripting skills (e.g., PML, C\#, .NET, SQL, REST APIs)
* Familiarity with enterprise IT environments (Windows Server, databases, cloud platforms)
* Excellent problem\-solving and analytical skills
* Effective communication skills in English (written and verbal)
* Experience working in cross\-functional and international team.
* Willingness to travel for project delivery and customer engagement

**Services at AVEVA**


Our dynamic global team of 700\+ engineers, developers, consultants, solution architects and project managers are at the forefront of delivering AVEVA cutting\-edge solutions to customers. The work is complex and technical, but immensely rewarding: we empower customers to harness the full transformative potential of AVEVA’s solutions. If you’re analytical, pragmatic, and driven to make a tangible impact on the sustainability of the industrial sector, our team is the perfect place for you.


You’ll also be joining an award\-winning workplace. AVEVA is Great Place to Work® Certified™ in multiple countries, reflecting the culture our people create every day. Explore our awards and recognition.

Parental leave, additional leaves including emergency leave, childcare leave and extended childcare leave, well\-being support, flexible benefits, group insurances, car Allowances (depending on the role), company’s gift.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer
jobs.description:
**Job Summary**


Forward Deployed Engineers take a defined use case from nothing to a working, production\-grade system inside the customer's environment. That starts with knowing our platform deeply enough to combine its capabilities into solutions more complex than any single feature was designed for \- and where a customer's specific needs call for something beyond the standard functionality, building that missing piece themselves. This is the role that builds the use case: not a prototype handed to someone else to production, but the system that goes live.


This is a customer\-facing role. Understanding the customer's needs and the realistic possibilities of their technical environment \- and working in close, daily collaboration with them \- is what makes a deployment succeed. We're in daily working contact with the customer's engineers and executives, mostly online, with our team and theirs operating as one delivery unit with shared planning. Success is measured on the customer's numbers \- resolution rate, containment, response latency, CSAT, cost per contact \- and accountability continues past go\-live.


Forward Deployed Engineering brings together two disciplines that used to sit apart: conversation design and integration engineering. An engineer who can build the technical logic behind a scenario; a conversation designer who can design the flow of the conversation itself \- that is what an FDE is. We hire people who are genuinely strong in one of the two and want to grow the other \- expert in both is a direction of travel, not an entry bar. The role is based in Prague and is part of a global function with teams in EMEA and North America.


Please note this is a hybrid role with significant customer on\-site availability required.


**Responsibilities**

* Own the solution design: translate a stated business problem into a technical architecture that fits the customer’s actual processes, constraints and systems.
* Build the agent 01: design, build and iterate the first working version end to end \- the system that goes into production, not a hand\-off.
* Close product gaps: build the custom extensions, integrations, services and tooling the deployment requires, without waiting for core roadmap prioritization.
* Own the integration surface: systems of record, contact channels and data flows \- and, for voice deployments, the telephony path from carrier to agent.
* Evaluate, iterate, improve: define the workflow\-specific tests that determine whether this deployment actually works, and iterate against real traffic until the numbers move.
* Work as the customer’s technical counterpart: deploy alongside their engineers, monitor against the agreed KPIs, tune, and stay accountable past go\-live.
* Feed the platform: capture what you built as a reusable pattern and push recurring patterns toward the core product \- the field is our sensing arm.

  

**Requirements**  

* 2\+ years building and shipping software in a customer\-facing role \- solutions or forward\-deployed engineering, professional services delivery, integration engineering, or product engineering with direct customer exposure.
* Genuine depth in at least one of our two disciplines, and the appetite to grow the other: conversation and agent design (dialogue logic, prompting, flows, evaluation) or integration engineering (APIs, services, systems of record, data flows).
* Strong hands\-on coding in JavaScript/TypeScript, Python and/or C\#/.NET \- comfortable writing and maintaining production services, not only scripts.
* Solid working experience of SQL, Linux and Docker \- just as important as the languages above.
* Solid grasp of software architecture and API integration: authentication, webhooks, queues, error handling and failure modes.
* Experience distributing data across critically loaded infrastructure, and the ability to account for race conditions, deadlocks and thread safety when designing systems.
* Ability to work directly with customer engineers and executives \- distil a complex system into a clear explanation, present a design, and defend a trade\-off.
* A track record of owning a complex project end to end, against real deliverables and real dates.
* Comfort with ambiguity and with non\-deterministic systems: forming a hypothesis, building the evaluation that tests it, and iterating to a number.
* Willingness to travel.
* Professional English, used daily with colleagues in EMEA and North America; Czech strongly preferred for work with regional customers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Conversational AI or voice agents in production \- flow and prompt design, retrieval, tool calling, and evaluation harnesses against real traffic.
* Contact centre and CCaaS platforms (Genesys, Avaya, NICE, Five9, Amazon Connect) plus telephony fundamentals \- SIP, DTMF, transfer, failover.
* Integration with enterprise systems of record: CRM, ERP, data warehouses, custom internal APIs.
* Cloud and container deployment (Azure, AWS, Docker, Kubernetes).
* GDPR, ISO 27001, SOC 2 and data residency handled as architectural constraints, not paperwork.
* Using AI tooling as a core part of how you build, not a side tab you open occasionally.
* Additional Central European languages, particularly Slovak, Polish or German.

  

**Benefits**  

  

**About CallMiner**
Does the possibility of using artificial intelligence to improve human connection excite you? We agree!


CallMiner is the global leader in AI\-powered conversation intelligence and customer experience (CX) automation. Our industry\-recognized platform captures and analyzes 100% of omnichannel customer interactions delivering the insights organizations need to improve CX, enhance agent performance, and drive automation at scale. By combining advanced AI, industry\-leading analytics, and real\-time conversation intelligence, we empower organizations to uncover customer needs, optimize processes, and automate workflows and interactions. The result: higher customer satisfaction, reduced operational costs, and faster, data\-driven decisions. Trusted by leading brands in technology, media \& telecom, retail, manufacturing, financial services, healthcare, and travel \& hospitality, we help organizations transform customer insights into action.


CallMiner's core set of values – from maniacal customer focus and radical candor to team mentality and transparency – serve as a touchstone for what we strive to create in a workplace culture and weave through everything we do as a company. We believe that by building a team of brilliant, inspired people, we can truly accomplish amazing things together. We are committed to providing an inclusive and equitable workplace where everyone feels accepted, valued, and understood.


Our strong commitment to a positive environment continually earns us recognition as a top workplace, including Boston Globe Top Place to Work.

 **Benefits \+ Perks**
At CallMiner, we believe having a work\-life balance is key to being able to deliver your best every day. Our perks are designed to enhance your daily work experience, promote your personal growth, and help you achieve a better work\-life balance. From Maternity and Paternity Leave, ample Holidays, Fitness and Health Reimbursement, Tuition Reimbursement and more, we aim to provide an environment where you can thrive both professionally and personally.


We are an Equal Opportunity Employer that does not discriminate on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, ancestry, disability, sexual orientation, marital status, veteran status, gender identity, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

**We are looking for Test Automation Engineer** to join our engineering team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality, reliability, and performance of both **modern web applications and Android\-based applications** running on **embedded hardware platforms.**

  

You will work closely with **software developers, system architects, product owners, and QA engineers** to design, develop, and maintain **automated test solutions** throughout the software development lifecycle.  



  

Our team works on **Pre\-Recorded Announcement Machine (PRAM)** installed in the aircraft cabin. It is used by cabin crew to playback music during passenger boarding \& un\-boarding, and to play pre\-recorded announcements such as flight safety messages during taxi. **PRAM** interacts with a web interface for content management.

You will work as part of a cross\-functional team with responsibility for delivering projects from concept and requirements definition through development, qualification, certification, manufacturing readiness, and product entry into service.  



  

Honeywell Aerospace products and services are found on aircraft across commercial aviation, defense and space — from engines and cockpit electronics to cabin systems, mechanical components and connectivity solutions. Our technology helps operators fly more safely, reduce fuel consumption, improve on\-time performance and deliver a better experience for the people on board.  



  

As aviation continues to evolve, we're also developing systems to support autonomous and supersonic platforms, bringing the same focus on safety and efficiency to the next era of flight. With approximately 36,000 employees worldwide and net sales of $17\.4B in 2025, Honeywell Aerospace is one of the largest dedicated aerospace companies in the world. jobs.description:
##### **Project description**


Luxoft is an industry\-leading software integrator and solution house for automotive OEMs and suppliers. There are millions of cars on the road today with solutions designed by DXC\-Luxoft.
  

  

You will work with one of the biggest car manufacturer to design and implement a cloud foundation platform for customer's workloads and business applications. You will design and adopt a secure and compliant cloud environment along with the implementation of governance foundation services to accelerate and streamline the onboarding of customer's solutions to the cloud.
  

  

A Data Mesh platform built on top of it to exchange, integrate, and process data from multiple internal systems. The Data Mesh platform applies domain\-oriented data ownership, treats data as a product, and uses federated governance, enabling controlled data usage to support future AI applications.
  

AI Labs is a sub\-product of the Data Mesh platform: an interface and services layer that gives teams self\-serve access to the AI\-ready datasets they need, without having to connect to each underlying source system individually.
  

The solution is designed and built through iterative collaboration with the client's team and other stakeholders to identify, manage, and document requirements across data domains. Our approach is iterative, adaptive, and proactive: each team member owns a specific domain area and its deliverables, and coordinates closely with that domain's data owners and downstream consumers.

* BS degree in Computer Science or related technical field or equivalent practical experience
* Solid experience with Microsoft Azure: IaaS, Azure AD, Azure Governance, Azure Functions, Azure Automation, Azure Monitor, Fabric, Foundry, Purview etc.
* Experience in architecting, designing, and deployment of application software at scale, using Agile methodologies, and with recent coding experience in two or more of the following languages: C\#, PowerShell, Python

* Deep understanding and experience with IaC principles and tools like Azure ARM Templates (Terraform is a plus)

* Experience with IT compliance and risk management requirements (eg., security, privacy, etc.)
* Strong verbal and written communication skills and ability to lead effectively across organizations
* Fluent in English

  

Preferred Skills
  

  

* Strong coding skills (e.g. C\#, PowerShell)
* Experience with MS Fabric, MS Foundry, Purview
* Strong experience in cloud security and compliance
* Familiarity with SIEM and SOAR solutions
* Deep understanding of authorization protocols like OAuth, OpenID, etc.

Design components such as OneLake, data mesh, and semantic layers.


Develop cloud architectural strategies ensuring security, scalability, and compliance.


Serve as a trusted advisor to align technical solutions with strategic objectives and advocate customer interests among diverse stakeholders.


Design and implement governance automation leveraging modern technologies and cloud best practices.


Lead technical collaboration with business, development, and infrastructure teams.


Produce technical documentation, architecture decision records, and implement DevOps practices including infrastructure as code, continuous integration, and automated deployments.


Coordinate team resources, resolve technical issues, and work within Agile frameworks, including Scrum and Kanban, for defining, estimating, and delivering work.

jobs.title: Principal Cloud Architect
jobs.description:
**The Role**

  

 The Evolve programme is accelerating Euroclear’s adoption of public cloud by establishing secure, resilient and scalable foundations, architecture standards and reusable implementation patterns. It brings together architecture, engineering, security, operations and migration stakeholders to enable workloads to move to and operate effectively on Azure in line with Euroclear’s business, risk and regulatory requirements.

  

 As Principal Cloud Architect, you will act as a senior architecture leader for cloud adoption. You will set architecture direction across a broad, cross\-organisational scope; help mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority into an effective and sustainable decision\-making body; steer cloud foundation priorities; govern architecture artefacts and reference implementations; and provide pragmatic guidance to workload teams.

  

 The role combines strategic architecture leadership, hands\-on delivery support and cross\-functional decision\-making. A key outcome is to expand Euroclear’s cloud presence responsibly by turning cloud strategy and principles into actionable standards, deployable patterns and sound workload decisions.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

**Cloud Solution Design Authority**

* Mature the Cloud Solution Design Authority by clarifying its mandate, decision rights, intake process, governance, cadence, quality criteria and follow\-up of architecture decisions.
* Establish a sustainable operating rhythm that enables timely, traceable and risk\-informed decisions.
* Facilitate complex architecture discussions, document outcomes and ensure that decisions, conditions and actions have clear owners.
* Improve the quality and consistency of architecture submissions by providing guidance, templates and early engagement.
  

 Cloud Foundations and Roadmap

* Refine, prioritise and maintain the cloud foundation roadmap across identity, connectivity, security, governance, management, operations and automation.
* Balance migration demand, risk reduction, platform scalability, technical debt and delivery capacity when setting priorities.
* Identify cross\-platform dependencies and sequence foundation capabilities so that workload teams can adopt cloud safely and efficiently.
* Advise programme and technology leadership on architecture choices, investment priorities and delivery trade\-offs.
  

 Architecture Direction and Artefacts

* Develop, maintain and govern cloud architecture principles, standards, target\-state designs, roadmaps and architecture decision records.
* Translate enterprise strategy, regulatory expectations and delivery needs into clear architecture direction.
  

* Ensure cloud architecture remains aligned with enterprise, security, data, resilience and technology standards.
* Maintain traceability between strategic objectives, architecture decisions, implementation guidance and delivery outcomes.
  

 Reference Implementations and Reusable Patterns

* Prioritise reusable cloud patterns and reference implementations based on workload demand, risk reduction and strategic value.
* Guide their delivery so that approved patterns are deployable, testable, automated and consumable by workload teams.
* Translate architecture into infrastructure\-as\-code accelerators, policy\-driven guardrails and reusable platform services.
* Promote standardisation and governed self\-service while limiting manual fulfilment and one\-off solutions to justified exceptions.
  

 Workload Assessment and Migration Guidance

* Support migration teams and workload owners in assessing application architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability, compatibility and migration readiness.
* Recommend appropriate migration or modernisation strategies based on business value, criticality, compliance, lifecycle impact and technical feasibility.
* Help teams select the most appropriate service model, considering SaaS, PaaS, containers and IaaS without assuming that one model is universally optimal.
* Identify architecture gaps and convert assessment findings into actionable remediation, sequencing and decision points.
  

 Cloud Footprint and Regional Architecture

* Shape the expansion of Euroclear’s cloud footprint, including new\-region adoption, regional operating models and multi\-region approaches.
* Assess implications for foundations, connectivity, identity, security, data residency, resilience, operations, support and cost.
* Define architecture guidance for workload placement and regional deployment.
* Ensure exceptions to approved regions or patterns have documented rationale, risk assessment, ownership and approval.
  

 Sustainability and Net\-Zero Assessment

* Assess the cloud implications of sustainability and Net\-Zero\-related decisions.
* Evaluate architecture trade\-offs involving region selection, service choices, resource efficiency, carbon considerations, cost, resilience and performance.
  

* Promote efficient use of managed and cloud\-native services where they provide measurable value and acceptable risk.
* Ensure sustainability considerations are incorporated into architecture decisions and roadmaps without compromising security, regulation or service quality.
  

 Architecture Assurance

* Review solution designs and assess alignment with approved principles, standards, target architectures and reference patterns.
* Identify material risks, gaps and deviations, and provide clear recommendations to delivery teams and decision\-makers.
* Ensure exceptions have an explicit rationale, accountable owner, remediation action and expiry or review date.
* Track recurring deviations and use them to improve standards, patterns, platform capabilities and governance.
  

 Stakeholder Alignment and Leadership

* Work closely with Enterprise Architecture, Cloud Engineering, CISO, Production, Business Resilience, migration teams, programme leadership and workload owners.
* Resolve architectural dependencies and accelerate decisions across organisational boundaries.
* Influence senior business and IT stakeholders by making complex trade\-offs clear and decision\-ready.
* Challenge constructively and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.
  

 Architecture Community and Knowledge Transfer

* Coach and mentor architects and engineers working on cloud initiatives.
* Strengthen the architecture community through knowledge sharing, reviews, reusable guidance and lessons learned.
* Ensure cloud standards, patterns and decision processes are understood and applied consistently.
* Promote pragmatic, collaborative and outcome\-focused ways of working across architecture and delivery teams.
  

**Candidate Profile**

  

**Required Experience**

* Extensive experience as a cloud architect, enterprise architect or principal solution architect in large\-scale technology transformation.
  

* Demonstrated experience leading architecture across complex, cross\-organisational business and IT scopes.
* Strong practical knowledge of Microsoft Azure, including landing zones, identity and access management, network topology, security, governance, policy, management, observability and platform automation.
* Experience establishing or maturing design authorities, architecture review boards, decision processes and architecture assurance practices.
* Proven ability to develop and govern principles, standards, target architectures, roadmaps, architecture decision records, reference patterns and implementation guidance.
* Experience translating architecture into infrastructure\-as\-code accelerators, reference implementations, guardrails and consumable platform services.
* Practical experience assessing workload architecture, dependencies, data, security, resilience, operability and compatibility, and recommending migration or modernisation strategies.
* Experience designing or governing multi\-region cloud environments, including region selection, connectivity, data residency, resilience, operational support and cost trade\-offs.
* Strong understanding of security by design, policy\-driven governance, shared responsibility and risk\-proportionate control models.
* Experience in financial services, financial market infrastructure or another regulated environment.
* Good understanding of ICT risk, operational resilience, data protection and third\-party requirements relevant to regulated financial institutions.
* Proven ability to align senior stakeholders, facilitate complex decisions and communicate architecture recommendations clearly.
* Ability to balance strategic direction, portfolio prioritisation and detailed technical implementation challenges.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to make complex architecture topics clear, actionable and decision\-ready.
* Experience working in Agile, DevOps or hybrid delivery environments.
* Proficiency in English.
  

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience applying Microsoft Cloud Adoption Framework and enterprise\-scale Azure landing\-zone principles.
* Experience with cloud\-native and managed service adoption across SaaS, PaaS, containers and IaaS.
* Knowledge of application modernisation, integration architecture, APIs, event\-driven design, data platforms or container platforms.
* Experience with FinOps, cloud cost transparency and continuous optimisation.
  

* Experience assessing cloud sustainability and resource\-efficiency implications.
* Knowledge of post\-trade market infrastructure or comparable critical financial\-market environments.
* Familiarity with architecture frameworks such as Open Agile Architecture or TOGAF.
* Working proficiency in French or Dutch.
  

**Certifications**

  

 The following certifications are valued. Candidates are not expected to hold all of them, but should demonstrate relevant depth across Azure architecture, security and enterprise architecture:

* Azure Architecture: Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert.
* Azure Security: Microsoft Certified: Azure Security Engineer Associate or equivalent.
* DevOps and Automation: Microsoft Certified: DevOps Engineer Expert, Terraform certification or equivalent infrastructure\-as\-code accreditation.
* Enterprise Architecture: TOGAF, Open Agile Architecture or an equivalent architecture certification.
* Security and Risk: CISSP, CCSP, CISM, CRISC or equivalent.
* FinOps and Sustainability: FinOps Certified Practitioner or relevant cloud sustainability training.

  

**Please note that this is a permanent position, and we do not offer freelance/contract arrangement for the role**
 .

  

**In order to cultivate relationships and promote team spirit, we require your presence in the office for a minimum of 8 days per month.**  

 \#LI\-AK1

* Vakantie: 32 dagen. Je kunt ook 5 extra dagen kopen voor extra ontspanning.
* Om onze successen te vieren en plezier te maken komen we samen voor teamsporten, afterworks, teambuildingactiviteiten, ons jaarlijkse feest en veel meer.

  


**Je belangrijkste verantwoordelijkheden**

  

* Ontwerpen en modelleren van infrastructuurprojecten:
	+ Gebruik maken van InfraWorks en Civil 3D om ontwerpconcepten voor infrastructuur te visualiseren, simuleren en optimaliseren (wegen, spoorwegen, rioleringssystemen, etc.).
	+ Analyseren van topografische, geospatiale en geotechnische gegevens voor het creëren van realistische en betrouwbare modellen.
	+ Uitvoeren van dimensionering en berekeningen voor wegontwerpen, waterbeheer en andere infrastructuurnetwerken.
* Samenwerking met projectteams:
	+ Nauw samenwerken met interne teams en externe stakeholders om ervoor te zorgen dat ontwerpen voldoen aan specificaties en lokale normen.
	+ Coördineren met de ontwerp\-, engineering\- en constructieteams om de technische haalbaarheid van projecten te waarborgen.
* Analyseren van projectgegevens en simulaties uitvoeren:
	+ Integreren van geografische gegevens en andere informatie uit terreinmetingen in BIM\-modellen voor een efficiënter ontwerp\- en bouwproces.
	+ Gebruik maken van simulaties om de impact van het ontwerp te evalueren op milieu, kosten en tijd.
* Ondersteuning bij documentatie en rapporten:
	+ Ondersteunen bij het opstellen van projectdocumentatie, rapporten en presentaties voor klanten en belanghebbenden.

  





**We horen graag van mensen met**

  


* Minimaal een bachelor in Civiele Techniek, Bouwkunde of een gerelateerd vakgebied.
* Uitgebreide ervaring met **Autodesk InfraWorks** en **Civil 3D.**

	+ Autodesk Civil 3D: Ontwerpen van wegen, analyse van rioleringssystemen en het beheren van topografische en geotechnische data.
	+ BIM (Building Information Modeling): Bekwaamheid in het werken met BIM voor het optimaliseren van ontwerpprocessen en de samenwerking tussen verschillende teams.
* Grondige kennis van infrastructuurontwerp en \-modellering.
	+ Grondige kennis van **ontwerpprincipes voor hoofdwegen, primaire wegen en andere infrastructuurelementen.**
	+ Ervaring in het ontwerpen en modelleren van rioleringssystemen, wegen en andere civiele infrastructuur.
* Sterke communicatieve vaardigheden en ervaring met het werken in teamverband.
* Probleemoplossend vermogen en oog voor detail.

  



**Ons rekruteringsproces**


* Pre\-screeningsgesprek / diepgaand HR\-interview (op locatie of via Teams) met de Talent Acquisition Partner
* 1 of 2 inhoudelijke interviews (bij voorkeur op locatie) met uw toekomstige manager

  



Onderzoek toont aan dat mannen solliciteren wanneer ze aan 60% van de vereisten voldoen, terwijl vrouwen pas solliciteren wanneer ze ervan overtuigd zijn dat ze aan 100% voldoen. Laat je daardoor niet tegenhouden – we horen graag van je!

  


**Wie je bent**

* **Communicatievaardigheden**: Het vermogen om effectief en duidelijk te communiceren in het Nederlands met projectteams, klanten en andere belanghebbenden, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk.
* **Samenwerken in teamverband**: Ervaring met het werken in een multidisciplinair team en het succesvol bereiken van gezamenlijke ontwerpdoelen.

* **Oog voor detail:** Zorgvuldigheid en precisie in ontwerpwerkzaamheden, waarbij geen enkel detail over het hoofd wordt gezien.
* **Tijdbeheer en organisatie:** Het vermogen om meerdere projecten tegelijkertijd te beheren en prioriteiten te stellen om deadlines te halen

  


**Wie we zijn**

Klaar om je positieve impact vorm te geven? Sluit je dan aan bij Tractebel, onderdeel van de **ENGIE Groep**, en onze 5600 gepassioneerde **experts** wereldwijd die zich iedere dag inzetten om te bouwen aan een **duurzamere wereld**. **Mensen, ethiek, veiligheid en duurzaamheid zijn onze topprioriteiten.** Met Tractebel verkeer je in een unieke positie om een positieve impact te maken op de wereldwijde net zero\-doelstellingen. jobs.title: Software Architect
jobs.description:
Welcome to Vintia. We develop software solutions for ticketing, bookings, payments and access control. They help organisations in the leisure and attractions industry manage complex day\-to\-day processes with confidence and keep their operations running smoothly, even during peak periods.


Combined with the right hardware, services and integrations, our solutions ensure that everything behind the scenes works together effectively. The result is a smoother visitor experience before, during and after each visit.


Headquartered in Ypres, with offices in Kapellen, Nieuwegein, Andernach, France, the UK and the UAE, Vintia combines strong local expertise with an international outlook as part of SALTO WECOSYSTEM.


To support our continued international growth, we are looking for a **X** in **Location** with a passion for the leisure and attractions industry.

**The job in a nutshell**

* Contribute to the definition, validation, and maintenance of our software applications by applying best practices, development patterns, and engineering principles.
* Develop innovative, state\-of\-the\-art applications using technologies such as .NET Core, REST APIs, AWS, and Angular.
* Provide technical expertise and support throughout the design, development, testing, and integration phases of application delivery.
* Document technical solutions and collaborate with stakeholders to define both functional and non\-functional requirements.
* Act as a technical expert within the Product (Scrum) Team, sharing knowledge and supporting colleagues where needed.
* Collaborate with cross\-functional teams to drive efficiency, consistency, and successful project delivery.
* Ensure software solutions meet high standards for quality, security, scalability, reliability, and maintainability.
* Support the analysis and refinement of requirements together with the Product Owner and the wider cross\-functional team.
* Work closely with your teammates to deliver high\-quality solutions and achieve shared goals.
* Evaluate, recommend, and contribute to the implementation of new technologies, tools, and methodologies.

**What makes you unique?**

* You hold a degree in IT or have equivalent experience in software development.
* You have at least 5 years of experience in software development.
* You have experience working on at least one cloud\-based software project or have a solid background in web development.
* You are passionate about coaching and mentoring team members, helping them grow their expertise and improve software quality.
* You have strong knowledge of .NET Core, C\#, ASP.NET Web API, design principles, development patterns, databases, and ORM technologies.
* You have experience with, or a willingness to learn, service\-oriented architectures and microservices.
* Knowledge of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript, Angular, and Agile methodologies is considered a plus.
* Hands\-on experience with AWS infrastructure management, unit testing, and QA automation is an asset.
* You communicate clearly and effectively in both Dutch and English, both spoken and written.

**What makes us unique?**


At Vintia, you become part of a company with strong roots, ambitious plans and a clear focus on innovation. Our story started as a family business, and while we have grown into an international player within SALTO WECOSYSTEM, we continue to value a warm, approachable and people\-oriented way of working.


You can expect a challenging role in a flexible working environment built on trust. From flexible working hours to teleworking opportunities, we believe in giving people the space to do their best work. From day one, you will be welcomed by passionate colleagues who are happy to share their knowledge and help you find your way.


You will have plenty of opportunities to learn and grow, thanks to targeted training, hands\-on experience and the expertise of colleagues across the organisation. Our no\-nonsense culture is characterised by open communication, a flat structure and direct access to management.


In return for your commitment, you can count on an attractive salary package, including benefits. And because we believe that people perform at their best when there is room to connect and recharge, we also organise team buildings, monthly afterworks, sports activities and seasonal events.


We are proud to be Great Place to Work certified, thanks to the enthusiastic feedback of our employees.

**Will you become our new Vintian?**


Are you ready to help shape the future of Vintia? Take your chance and become a key player in our continued growth.


At Vintia, we believe that our strength lies in the diversity of our people. No matter who you are, what your dreams are, what you believe in or where you come from, you are welcome here.

jobs.title: Développeur .Net H/F
jobs.description:
**Chaque moment compte. Surtout ceux que vous vivez à fond. Bienvenue chez Consort Group.**


Consort Group, accompagne depuis plus de 30 ans les entreprises dans la valorisation de leurs données et infrastructures. Elle s'appuie sur deux leaders, Consortis et Consortia, et place l’humain et la responsabilité sociétale au cœur de ses valeurs.

**C’est votre future équipe**


Mobilisée pour la réussite de ses clients, l’équipe de Consort Belgium incarne les valeurs et partage les expertises de Consort Group à Bruxelles, dans ses environs, et sur l’ensemble du territoire belge. Forte de 45 collaborateurs, elle propose depuis 2016 une offre de services en Infrastructures et Solutions Applicatives, portée par des équipes locales et appuyée, lorsque nécessaire, par les compétences et ressources du groupe.

 **Développeur .Net H/F**

**C’est votre mission**


Vous êtes passionné·e par le développement backend et souhaitez contribuer à des applications métiers au sein d’un environnement technique riche et structuré ? Cette mission est faite pour vous.


En tant que **Développeur Backend .NET Médior**, vous participez au développement, à l’évolution et à la maintenance d’applications core business, dans un environnement Agile, en collaboration avec les analystes, architectes et autres développeurs.


Côté build :

* Concevoir et développer des applications et services backend en **C\# / .NET**, notamment en **.NET 8 et versions supérieures**
* Développer et faire évoluer des **API REST / WebAPI**
* Développer et maintenir des services **WCF, WCF REST et Web Services**
* Travailler sur des applications **ASP.NET** **MVC / WebForms** et des environnements .NET Framework
* Concevoir des solutions robustes, maintenables et performantes en appliquant les **principes SOLID, la programmation orientée objet et les Design Patterns**
* Développer et manipuler des données avec **Entity Framework Core**
* Travailler avec des bases de données **SQL Server** et **Oracle**
* Développer et intégrer des flux en **XML et JSON**, dans le respect des standards du web
* Participer aux revues de code et à la mise en place de tests unitaires
* Collaborer avec les analystes et architectes pour traduire les besoins fonctionnels et techniques en solutions adaptées
* Comprendre et interpréter des modèles **UML et BPMN**


Côté run :

* Assurer la **maintenance corrective et évolutive** des applications existantes
* Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents techniques
* Identifier et corriger les problèmes de performance au niveau applicatif et base de données
* Optimiser les requêtes et les accès aux données avec **Entity Framework Core / SQL**
* Participer au suivi et à l'amélioration de la qualité du code
* Documenter les solutions et partager les bonnes pratiques avec l’équipe
* Contribuer aux processus de développement et de livraison via **Azure DevOps et Git**

**C’est votre parcours**


Vous disposez de **plusieurs années d’expérience en développement backend .NET** et souhaitez évoluer dans un environnement applicatif complexe et structuré.


Vous appréciez les projets qui combinent développement de nouvelles fonctionnalités, maintenance d’applications existantes et résolution de problématiques techniques.


Vous êtes capable de travailler de manière autonome tout en collaborant étroitement avec les analystes, architectes et autres développeurs.

**C’est votre expertise**

* **C\# / .NET / .NET Core / .NET 8\+**
* **ASP.NET** **MVC / WebForms / .NET Framework**
* **REST / WebAPI / Web Services / WCF**
* **Entity Framework Core**
* **SQL Server** et **Oracle**
* **XML / JSON**
* **Azure DevOps**
* **Git** et idéalement **TFVC**
* **SOLID / programmation orientée objet / Design Patterns**
* **Tests unitaires**
* **Visual Studio**
* Méthodologies **Agile / Scrum**
* Connaissance de **UML / BPMN**
* La connaissance des outils **Redgate** constitue un atout


Une expérience pratique avec **Entity Framework Core**, notamment pour l’écriture, la lecture et l’optimisation de requêtes complexes, est attendue.

**C’est votre manière de faire équipe**

* Autonome dans la réalisation des développements confiés
* Esprit d’analyse et de résolution de problèmes
* Rigoureux·se et attentif·ve à la qualité du code
* Proactif·ve et orienté·e amélioration continue
* À l’aise dans la collaboration avec des profils techniques et fonctionnels
* Bonnes capacités de communication et de travail en équipe


Le contexte de travail est **majoritairement francophone**. Une excellente maîtrise du **français** est donc indispensable.

**C’est notre engagement**


Chez Consort Group, vous êtes un·e expert·e qu’on accompagne pour que chaque mission devienne une étape qui compte.

* Un onboarding attentif et humain
* Une vraie proximité managériale
* Des formations accessibles en continu
* Des engagements concrets : inclusion, égalité, solidarité
* Un package RH complet : mutuelle, carte TR, CSE, prévoyance
* Une culture du feedback et des projets qui font sens

**C’est clair**


Le process de recrutement :

* Un premier échange téléphonique avec notre team recrutement
* Un entretien RH ainsi qu’un échange métier avec un·e ingénieur·e d’affaires
* Un test ou un échange technique avec un·e de nos expert·es
* Un dernier point avec votre futur·e manager ou responsable de mission
* Et si on se reconnaît : on démarre ensemble

**C’est bon à savoir**

* **Lieu :** Bruxelles
* **Poste :** Développeur Backend .NET Médior
* **Contrat :** CDI / freelance
* **Télétravail :** 2 jours remote / 3 jours sur site
* **Salaire / tarif :** selon expérience
* **Famille métier :** Développement applicatif / Backend

**Ce que vous ferez ici, vous ne le ferez nulle part ailleurs.**  

**Ce moment, c’est le vôtre.**

**Software \& System Engineer**

* Entwicklung und Implementierung von Softwarelösungen im Bereich der Signaltechnik Bahnanwendungen
* Unterstützung bei der Planung, Durchführung und Dokumentation von Softwaretests in verschiedenen Umgebungen (Simulation, Labor, Fahrzeug)

jobs.description:
**Job Description**  

Help shape the future of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC) machine protection systems. We are looking for a motivated Engineer to contribute to the renovation of the LHC Collimator Control System, a critical component ensuring the safe and reliable operation of the world's most powerful particle accelerator. Working in a highly collaborative environment you will help to increase the reliability, usability, and long\-term maintainability of systems at the heart of LHC operations. This is a unique opportunity to combine software development, controls engineering, and accelerator technology while making a tangible impact on CERN's flagship facility.

**Your responsibilities**

* Develop and maintain control applications for the LHC Collimator system using the FESA framework, ensuring integration within CERN's accelerator control environment.
* Coordinate and support control system commissioning, performing functional testing, validation, and verification of interlocks and fail\-safes prior to operational deployment.
* Integrate control systems with the alarm server and develop high\-level tools to enhance usability and real\-time monitoring.
* Contribute to the design and validation of system\-level tests, including functional, integration, and regression testing.
* Support expert and operational interfaces, providing diagnostic capabilities and improving intervention workflows.

**Your profile**

* Demonstrated experience in real\-time or distributed control systems, preferably within accelerator, industrial automation, or scientific environments.
* Experience in interventions in complex industrial or technical environments.
* Experience developing and maintaining expert interfaces (GUIs, web tools) for control and diagnostics.
* Experience with software version control (e.g. Git) and CI/CD workflows.


Skills

* Proficiency in C\+\+.
* Knowledge of Python.
* Skilled in system integration, commissioning, and validation of control applications for hardware\-software systems.
* Strong ability to troubleshoot, analyse, and document complex technical issues in operational environments.
* Proactive, organised, and collaborative, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary engineering teams and communicate technical progress clearly.
* Spoken and written English, with a commitment to learn French.


Eligibility criteria:

* You are a national of a CERN Member or Associate Member State.
* You have a professional background in Controls Engineering, Computer Science, Electronic Engineering (or a related field) and have either:
	+ a **Master's degree with 2 to 6 years** of post\-graduation professional experience;
	+ or a **PhD with no more than 3 years** of post\-graduation professional experience.
* You have never had a CERN fellow or graduate contract before.

  

**Additional Information**  

Job closing date: **18\.10\.2026 at 23:59 CEST.**


Contract duration: 24 months, with a possible extension up to 36 months maximum.


Working hours: 40 hours per week


Job flexibility: Fully Onsite


Target start date: 01\-January\-2027


Job reference: BE\-CEM\-MRO\-2026\-156\-GRAP


Field of work: Information Technologies


Benchmark job: 200020 \- Computing Engineer

**Global Benefits**

* A monthly net stipend of either 6372 or 7004 Swiss Francs per month depending on your degree.
* 30 days of paid leave per year plus 2 weeks annual closure.
* Coverage by CERN’s comprehensive health insurance scheme (for yourself, your spouse and children), and membership of the CERN Pension Fund.
* Family, child and infant monthly allowances depending on your individual circumstances.
* A relocation package (installation grant and travel expenses) depending on your individual circumstances.
* Possibility to extend your contract up to 36 months.
* On\-the\-job and formal training including language classes.

**Overview of CERN \- Discover a world where the impossible is made possible!**


At CERN, the European Organization for Nuclear Research, we are pushing the frontiers of science and technology. Our groundbreaking work brings together not only physicists but also a diverse range of professionals from engineering, technical, scientific, and administrative fields. Together, we foster an environment where innovation and collaboration thrive.


Every day, we face exciting new challenges and opportunities to contribute to cutting\-edge research that shapes our understanding of the universe. We meet these challenges through the diverse perspectives within our teams, ensuring every contribution is valued and driving our shared sense of inclusion and purpose. Diversity is a core value of CERN since its foundation, and it remains central to our mission and continued success.


If you are ready to be part of a dynamic, inclusive community pushing the boundaries of knowledge, CERN is the place where your curiosity and skills can thrive. Be part of our mission to uncover what lies at the heart of the universe! **TAKE PART!**

jobs.title: Splunk Solutions Engineer - Switzerland
jobs.description:

Splunk, a Cisco company, is building a resilient digital world with an end\-to\-end platform designed for hybrid, multi\-cloud environments. We approach our work with kindness, valuing the unique talents, passion, and joy that each team member brings to our collaborative culture. We foster an environment of inclusiveness, disruption, and fun, ensuring that every member feels supported as they reach new heights.

As a Splunk Solutions Engineer, you will serve as a trusted technical advisor to our enterprise customers and partners. You will design and deliver innovative technical solutions that directly address business needs, ensuring long\-term customer success in the region.

* Serve as the primary technical sales engineer and trusted advisor for customers and partners in Switzerland to drive technology adoption. The focus is on global accounts in the financial services and insurance sectors.
* Design and present relevant Splunk and Cisco technical solutions based on identified business requirements to solve enterprise challenges.

* Guide a virtual support team of sales resources to efficiently move deals through the technical sales process.

* Working with Global Splunk and CIsco diverse teams.

* Develop and maintain deep expertise of Splunk’s portfolio, use\-cases, and its alignment to customer challenges and objectives
* Provide active feedback to Sales teams regarding strategic customer needs, market opportunities, and competitive tactics to inform product strategy.
* Dedicate the majority of your selling time to landing new opportunities and growing our footprint within existing accounts.

Minimum qualifications
  
  

* 5\+ years of experience in Solutions Engineering, or a related technical sales role within the enterprise software industry.

* Available to travel up to 50% to visit prospects and customers across Switzerland and internationally if needed.

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.

Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 48,000 employees in 45 attractive markets – across Europe, Latin America, Asia, Middle East \& Africa. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundations and flooring to roofing and walling – powered by premium brands including ECOPlanet, ECOPact, and ECOCycle®. Find out more at www.holcim.com


**WHO IS HOLCIM?**
  

As a global leader in innovative and sustainable building solutions, Holcim is enabling greener cities, smarter infrastructure and improving living standards around the world. With sustainability at the core of our strategy, we are becoming a net\-zero company, with our people and communities at the heart of our success. We are driving circular construction as a world leader in recycling to build more with less. It’s all thanks to our 70,000 talented people around the world who are passionate about building progress for people and the planet through four business segments: Cement, Ready\-Mix Concrete, Aggregates and Solutions \& Products.


**WHO ARE HOLCIM PEOPLE**
  

Holcim people are passionate about finding better ways to build. They embrace innovation and improvement with a pioneering spirit. They work as trusted partners, creating better solutions and experiences for their customers, communities, and colleagues.


Holcim is the leading partner for sustainable construction with net sales of CHF 15\.7 billion in 2025, creating value across the built environment from infrastructure and industry to buildings. Headquartered in Zug, Switzerland, Holcim has more than 50 000 employees in 45 countries – across Europe, Latin America and Asia, Middle East \& Africa – and has been recognized as a Global Top Employer by the Top Employers Institute. Holcim offers high\-value end\-to\-end Building Materials and Building Solutions, from foundation and flooring to walling and roofing – powered by premium brands including ECOPact, ECOPlanet, ECOCycle, and Ytong.

  

**Role Overview**

  

The **Operational Technology Engineer** is a specialized strategic role focused on the design, deployment, standardisation, and governance of Industrial Control Systems (ICS) and Manufacturing Execution Systems (MES) \- internally identified as Technical Information Systems (TIS). Acting as the critical bridge between TIS, ICS and the ERP, this role ensures the integrity, cyber\-resilience and continuous availability of operational data across the global organization.  

  

  

  

This role requires an innovative engineer to drive automation and digital transformation by serving high\-fidelity data to advanced analytics, IIoT platforms, and optimization tools. The ideal candidate thrives in a high\-performance culture, demonstrates a strong commitment to operational sustainability, and acts as a catalyst for continuous learning and technology adoption.  

  

  

**Main Responsibilities**

  

The Operational Technology Engineer plays a critical role in standardizing and optimizing automation systems to capture, analyse, and leverage production data, driving operational efficiency across all industrial processes.  

  

  

**1\. Strategy \& Standardization**  

* Collaborate in define and implement corporate\-wide ICS/TIS standards to ensure global consistency in KPIs, reporting structures, and data architecture across 100\+ plants

* Align OT strategy in line with corporate guidance with business goals, identifying emerging technology needs and establishing multi\-year technical roadmaps.

* Drive innovation and industrial transformation: implement Plant of Tomorrow (PoT) solutions to improve efficiency, productivity, and competitiveness.

* Train and mentor the OT plant teams: build high\-performing operational plant teams through training and development, focusing on ICS and TIS systems.

* Educate and advise plant OT related risks and opportunities

* Support the product roadmap for new functionalities and features within the PCS/MES ecosystem.

* Design and maintain robust interfaces between the shop floor (PCS/DCS), laboratory (LIMS), and business layers (SAP).

  

  

  

**2\. Global Deployment \& Operations**  

* Support the full lifecycle of ICS/MES deployments, from initial site assessment and vendor coordination to post\-go\-live support and version upgrades.

* Ensure reliability of the ICS/TIS environment, coordinating with IT and external vendors.

* Develop, optimize, and troubleshoot industrial data communication protocols and networking standards (e.g., Modbus, OPC UA/DA/HDA).

* Optimize production data streams to improve overall process efficiency and support decarbonization/sustainability goals.

  

  

**3\. Data Governance \& Security**  

* Uphold the highest standards of data quality, integrity, and confidentiality to support "Smart Operations" and advanced analytics.

* Collaborate with the Cybersecurity team to implement robust protective measures for OT data systems against evolving cyber threats.

* Maintain comprehensive documentation for data architecture and standard operating procedures (SOPs).

  

  

**4\. Leadership \& Knowledge Management**  

* Design and execute global training programs to upskill plant\-level PCS, TIS, PIMS, and LIMS champions.

* Manage a centralized corporate knowledge base, including engineering standards, operational manuals and troubleshooting guides.

* Influence senior stakeholders and plant management to ensure buy\-in for digital initiatives and technical standards.

**5\. Collaboration \& Communication:**  

* Work cross\-functionally with Maintenance, Process/Production, Quality Control, Corporate IT, and PM\&E to ensure end\-to\-end system integration and alignment.

**6\. Operational Management**  

* Oversee site\-level OT performance, ensuring smooth, secure, and efficient multi\-plant operations. Implement and enforce cybersecurity measures: protect OT systems from cyber threats and vulnerabilities through OT cybersecurity controls.

  

  

**Your Profile**

  

**Level of education/qualifications normally required:**  

* MS or PhD in Electrical, Electronic, or Automation Engineering.

* (preferred) ISA/IEC 62443 OT cybersecurity certificate

  

  

**Experience**  

* 3 years’ experience as plant automation/systems engineer for process industry

* 3 years’ in managing industrial data systems (Historians, MES) and industrial networking.

* 3 years’ experience in cement (advantage)

  

  

**Technical / functional skills:**  

* Deep understanding of OT systems in the process industry: This includes industrial control systems, SCADA systems, distributed control systems (DCS), programmable logic controllers (PLCs), and manufacturing execution systems.

* Understanding of OT security threats, vulnerabilities, and mitigation strategies. Familiarity with security frameworks and standards like IEC 62443\.

* Knowledge of industrial networking protocols like Ethernet/IP, Profinet, Modbus, and OPC UA.

* Knowledge of cloud platforms and IoT technologies relevant to industrial environments, JavaScript and prototyping languages such as Python

* In\-depth understanding of continuous cement manufacturing processes, instrumentation, and sensor technologies.

.  

**Language skills:**  

* English (technical fluency critical)

  

* Spanish, German and French are an advantage

  

  

  

**Mobility requirements:**  

* 30% international traveling worldwide

  

  

**Benefits**


* Hybrid work contract
* Family Support: Subsidized child care and paid maternity/paternity leave
* Professional Growth: Company\-sponsored training and professional development.
* Discounts and Perks: Subsidized meals, exclusive discounts, and company gifts for special occasions.
* Long\-service awards
* Employee referral bonus
* Pension and Savings: Access to a comprehensive pension fund and an employee savings scheme.

*Holcim is committed to a diverse and inclusive workplace. We support equal opportunities for everyone, regardless of race, national origin, gender, sexuality, disability, or age.*

  

*Important Notice: Holcim recruiters only contact candidates via official @\[holcim.com] email addresses. We do not use Gmail or any other non\-Holcim domains to conduct recruitment processes. Please verify the sender address before responding."*

jobs.title: Senior Data Architect, Scientific Data Platform
jobs.description:
**Job Description**
-------------------

  

Agilent instruments produce the measurements behind pharmaceutical quality control, food and environmental testing, and research labs worldwide. That data sits in dozens of software products, and we are building a platform that lets our products, our customers' workflows, and AI agents find and use it wherever it lives.

  

We are hiring a data architect to own the discovery and access side of that platform: how scientific data is registered and found, and how it is composed and served. The platform architecture is established; the target state for discovery and access, and the path to it, are yours to define.

  

You work under the Lead Data Architect, who owns cross\-service standards and governance. Within your areas, the architecture decisions are yours; cross\-service decisions go to the Lead with evidence, options, and a recommendation.

  

This is an architecture role with hands\-on evidence: you decide the architecture for your areas, stay with engineering through implementation, and read the code, run the queries, and build the proof of concept when an argument needs one.

 **Your areas:**

* Data access. Your part of the federated GraphQL gateway, which the platform team owns how connected systems are represented on it, directly or through data services; the read layer that composes results across systems; and the application data services that expose access\-controlled views of scientific data to products, workflows, and AI consumers.
* Catalog and search. The catalog record model, how connected systems register their data and how that metadata is represented, search over it, and the path to richer indexes like vector and graph.

  

Access is the first\-year priority; catalog work runs alongside as the first connectors land. File management, metadata extraction, and semantic standards are owned by other architects on the team. The data is scientific data created by software products: results, methods, samples, files. ERP, CRM, and other enterprise business systems are out of scope.

 **What you will do:**

* Establish how the catalog and access paths behave today and define the target state: service boundaries, contracts, integration patterns, and the path between the two.
* Own the schemas and contracts your areas depend on: catalog records, subgraph boundaries, data service views, and versioned event schemas. Design them and make explicit which system is authoritative for each piece of information under the program's data governance rules, and version them so existing consumers keep working.
* Design the access paths AI agents use to read what they can, under what controls, and with what provenance.
* Review proposed integrations against your contracts and the program's participation requirements. Change your contracts when the evidence warrants and propose changes to the requirements.
* Design modernization paths for legacy sources that keep customers running through the transition, including moves from on\-premises to hybrid or cloud.
* Set query and index performance targets for catalog and access paths.
* Design the pipelines that keep the catalog, the search index, and the access views current as data arrives, from extractor output through backfill and recovery.
* Work directly with engineering: clarify designs, evaluate implementation plans, review delivered work against the decisions.
* Write the decision records and diagrams for your areas, and explain the tradeoffs to engineers, product managers, and business stakeholders.

 **What we work with:**

* .NET (C\#) services, Angular front ends, and a federated GraphQL gateway
* PostgreSQL by default, with Oracle and SQL Server across the installed base
* RabbitMQ for messaging and event\-driven change discovery
* Kubernetes and Helm alongside Windows installers for on\-premises and hybrid customers, with S3\-compatible object storage
* Scientific data in proprietary instrument formats as well as vendor\-neutral formats like Allotrope
* AI assistants in daily use

**Qualifications**
------------------

 **Required qualifications:**

* Has 8\+ years in software engineering, data engineering, or architecture with distributed systems: service boundaries, APIs, and event\-driven integration.
* Has defined architecture ahead of finalized standards and governance and can show which decisions held up and which had to change.
* Has owned the architecture of a production system in at least one of these areas: data catalogs and metadata management (DataHub, OpenMetadata, or similar); search and indexing (Elasticsearch, OpenSearch, or similar); API or federated\-query data access layers (Apollo Federation, or similar); or the data layer of a scientific, laboratory, or regulated application.
* Writes SQL and reads execution plans in PostgreSQL or SQL Server.
* Has built and run data pipelines, including recovery and backfill.
* Reads production code in a typed language (C\#, Java, TypeScript, or similar) and can build a proof of concept.
* Uses AI tools in daily architecture and data work (profiling and cleaning data, reading and generating code, drafting decision records) and can show the process: what you delegate, what you verify, and how.
* Works across product, engineering, and business teams without direct authority.

 **Preferred qualifications:**

* Has delivered data products consumed by applications: APIs, views, or datasets that other software depends on.
* Working knowledge of catalog, search, and data access beyond the area you have owned.
* Laboratory informatics or regulated life sciences, including data integrity and audit trail expectations.
* Architecture decision records, C4 or similar diagrams, and interface contracts.
* Cloud integration patterns (identity, storage, messaging, managed data services) alongside on\-premises deployment.

 **Additional Details**


This job has a full time weekly schedule. It includes the option to work remotely.
Our pay ranges are determined by role, level, and location. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job\-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Pay and benefit information by country are available at: https://careers.agilent.com/locations

Jij versterkt team TEC, het data\- en integratieteam dat systemen binnen de Rechtspraak met elkaar laat praten. Als Java/Kotlin developer bouw jij de datakoppelingen die dat mogelijk maken. Soms komt de informatie voor één toepassing uit vijf of zes verschillende bronnen. Daar zit de grote puzzel: waar haal je welke data vandaan, hoe breng je die goed bij elkaar en hoe zorg je dat andere teams ermee verder kunnen?
  

  

Het aantal datavragen groeit. Collega\-teams kloppen vaker bij TEC aan en de lat ligt hoog: gegevens moeten soms binnen een paar seconden beschikbaar zijn. Voor jou betekent dat technisch uitdagend werk met Java, Kotlin, Spring Boot, OCP, AMQ en MongoDB. * Den Bosch
